title: The Impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act on Capital Investment in Publicly Traded United States Manufacturing Firms through 2020

detail.title: The Impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act on Capital Investment in Publicly Traded United States Manufacturing Firms through 2020
detail.abstract: The 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) represents the most significant tax overhaul since the Tax Reform Act of 1986, and one of the most substantial fiscal policies in American history. This paper examines the impact of the TCJA on capital investment in publicly traded U.S. manufacturing firms through 2020. It first outlines the corporate provisions of the TCJA, then delineates three classic theoretical models of how business investment should respond to tax cuts. The evidence indicates that the TCJA’s effect on investment was weaker than expected. Instead, firms redirected resources towards stock purchases and liquidity hoarding. These results, which strikingly diverge from theoretical expectations, highlight the need for further research linking tax policy and corporate behavior.

AI.tldr: 2017年减税与就业法案(TCJA)对美国制造业上市公司资本投资的影响研究显示，税收减免对投资的刺激效果弱于预期，企业反而将资源转向股票回购和流动性囤积。
AI.research_question: TCJA税收改革对上市公司制造业资本投资的影响如何？
AI.motivation: TCJA是自1986年以来最重要的税收改革，也是美国历史上最重大的财政政策之一，需要评估其对企业投资行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三种经典的税收减免如何影响企业投资的理论模型
AI.method: 实证分析2017-2020年间美国制造业上市公司的投资行为数据
AI.findings: TCJA对投资的刺激效果弱于理论预期，企业将资源转向股票回购和流动性囤积而非实体投资
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税收政策与企业实际行为之间的理论预期与现实差异，挑战了传统税收激励理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了税收改革实际效果的实证证据，提示需要重新思考税收政策与企业投资行为的关系

title: A Conditional Reduction of the Hodge Conjecture Via Hyperplane Sections, Leray Theory, And Spreading of Cycles
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Conditional Reduction of the Hodge Conjecture Via Hyperplane Sections, Leray Theory, And Spreading of Cycles
detail.abstract: We develop a conditional framework that reduces the Hodge Conjecture on a smooth projective variety X to Hodge for its complete intersection sections, using a detailed blend of Leray spectral sequences, Deligne's global invariant cycle theorem, limit mixed Hodge structures, and Voisin's spread of cycles. A key technical output is a Patching Theorem that upgrades fiberwise algebraicity for very general sections to a global algebraic cycle on X after Gysin pushforward, provided primitive obstructions vanish or are controlled by algebraic correspondences. As a substantive sharpening, we prove a reduction for codimension-p classes that requires only the Lefschetz (1, 1)-theorem on codimension-(p-1) linear sections (hence no lower-dimensional Hodge input), together with a Noether-Lefschetz type vanishing and algebraicity of primitive projectors on X. We illustrate the method on surfaces and threefolds, and discuss families where the Noether-Lefschetz hypothesis is expected to hold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个条件框架，将光滑射影簇X上的Hodge猜想约化到其完全交截面的Hodge猜想。通过Leray谱序列、Deligne全局不变循环定理、极限混合Hodge结构和Voisin的循环展开等技术，证明了关键的Patching定理，并在满足特定条件时将纤维代数性提升为全局代数循环。
AI.research_question: 如何将光滑射影簇上的Hodge猜想约化到其完全交截面上的Hodge猜想？
AI.motivation: Hodge猜想是代数几何中的核心未解决问题，通过约化方法可以将其简化为更简单的情形来处理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Leray谱序列、Deligne全局不变循环定理、极限混合Hodge结构、Voisin循环展开理论等现代代数几何工具。
AI.method: 开发条件框架，使用谱序列分析、混合Hodge结构理论、Gysin推前操作，并证明关键的Patching定理。
AI.findings: 建立了将Hodge猜想约化的条件框架，证明了Patching定理，给出了仅需Lefschetz (1,1)定理和Noether-Lefschetz型消失条件的约化结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了Hodge猜想约化的新方法，发展了Patching定理等关键技术，深化了对Hodge类代数性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为具体验证Hodge猜想提供了可行的约化路径，特别是在曲面和三重形等低维情形中展示了方法的有效性。

title: Which Approach Better Samples Extreme Traffic Conflicts? Conventional- vs. Machine Learning-Based Sampling Methods
affiliations: Toronto Metropolitan University, Lund University, Lund University, Toronto Metropolitan University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Which Approach Better Samples Extreme Traffic Conflicts? Conventional- vs. Machine Learning-Based Sampling Methods
detail.abstract: Extreme value theory has been receiving much attention of late for proactively estimating crash risk through a two-step procedure that first sample extreme traffic conflicts and then estimates crash risk based on those sampled extremes. Although the existing body of research has encapsulated sampling methods within a predominant conventional technique, there is no universally accepted practice on how to efficiently select threshold values; neither is there an answer as to why the sampled extreme conflicts may not align with the conceptual crash severity level framework. This research aims to address these issues by utilizing machine learning-based sampling methods and comparing them with a conventional sampling method. After a cursory review of recent developments in machine learning techniques in transportation and other engineering fields, two machine learning sampling models, autoencoder neural network and isolation forest, were investigated using a database of vehicle-to-pedestrian conflicts at urban signalized intersections. Sampled extreme conflicts using machine learning as well as conventional sampling techniques were assessed and compared using two criteria -- their alignment with the conceptual severity level framework, and their compatibility with the extreme value distribution. The results demonstrate that the extreme conflicts selected based on the machine learning methods better mirror the conceptual severity levels than the conventional sampling technique. Moreover, extremes classified by the isolation forest sampling method were seen to be a better fit to the extreme value distribution compared to the autoencoder neural network and the conventional sampling method.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习方法（自编码器神经网络和孤立森林）改进极端交通冲突采样，相比传统方法能更好地匹配概念严重性框架和极值分布。
AI.research_question: 如何通过机器学习方法改进极端交通冲突采样，使其更好地匹配概念严重性框架和极值分布？
AI.motivation: 现有极端值理论在交通冲突采样中缺乏统一的阈值选择方法，且采样结果与概念碰撞严重性框架不一致，需要更有效的采样技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极端值理论、机器学习理论（自编码器神经网络、孤立森林）、交通冲突严重性概念框架
AI.method: 使用自编码器神经网络和孤立森林两种机器学习采样方法，与传统采样方法进行比较，基于城市信号交叉口车辆-行人冲突数据库进行评估
AI.findings: 机器学习方法选择的极端冲突比传统方法更好地反映了概念严重性水平；孤立森林采样方法比自编码器神经网络和传统方法更符合极值分布
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于机器学习的极端交通冲突采样新方法，丰富了极端值理论在交通安全中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通工程师提供了更有效的极端冲突识别工具，有助于更准确地估计碰撞风险和制定安全改进措施

title: Addressing the Limitations of Election and Sortition With Jury-Based Deliberative Democracy
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: Addressing the Limitations of Election and Sortition With Jury-Based Deliberative Democracy
detail.abstract: Randomly selected representative bodies have the potential to address seemingly intractable problems with electoral systems. However, existing designs are at risk of becoming polarized, insular, and corrupt like elected legislatures. I propose three systems based on short-term, evaluative, conclusive, and multi-choice juries, which are supported by contemporary and historical precedent. These large random juries choose between options proposed by elected legislators, reducing gridlock and polarization. This hybrid approach leverages the differing strengths of politicians and jurors, separating partisan proposers and dispassionate deciders to make both more effective. The three proposed designs address the limitations of both pure sortition and election, achieving the responsiveness and equality of sortition, while retaining the expertise and participation of election. First, deliberative law uses juries to choose agenda items and bills from among those proposed by legislators. Second, deliberative appointment uses juries to choose from among candidates nominated by legislators for judicial and independent executive positions. Finally, a deliberative senate is selected through deliberative appointment in each region. These designs of deliberative government provide a pragmatic pathway for testing and adoption by retaining existing systems while addressing their flaws.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种基于随机抽选陪审团的混合治理系统，结合选举制与抽选制的优势，通过分离提案者与决策者角色来减少政治僵局和极化问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计混合治理系统来克服选举制和纯粹抽选制的局限性，同时解决政治极化、僵局和腐败问题？
AI.motivation: 现有选举系统容易产生极化、封闭和腐败，而纯粹抽选制又缺乏专业性和参与度，需要一种结合两者优势的混合方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机抽选理论、审议民主理论和制度设计理论，强调分离提案者（政治家）和决策者（陪审团）角色的重要性。
AI.method: 理论构建和制度设计方法，提出三种具体的混合治理模型：审议立法、审议任命和审议参议院。
AI.findings: 提出的三种混合系统能够实现抽选制的响应性和平等性，同时保留选举制的专业性和参与度，有效减少政治僵局和极化。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了混合治理理论，提出了分离提案与决策功能的制度设计原则，丰富了审议民主和随机治理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了三种具体可行的治理改革方案，为现有政治系统的渐进式改革提供了实用路径，可在保留现有制度的同时解决其缺陷。

title: The Inconvenience of (Relative) Tranquility: An Exercise of Balance in the Balkan Powder Keg
affiliations: Amsterdam Center for International Law

detail.title: The Inconvenience of (Relative) Tranquility: An Exercise of Balance in the Balkan Powder Keg
detail.abstract:
The study examines the role of the main actors projecting their influence in the region—the European Union, Russia, the United States, Turkey, and China—and highlights the need for a much firmer and results-oriented European approach in the enlargement process.

The paper argues that although the EU remains the only viable long-term option for the region’s stability, hesitations and imposed conditionalities risk creating a geopolitical vacuum, susceptible to being filled by disruptive forces. Without a renewed strategic commitment, the Balkans risk oscillating between relative calm and structural instability, generating challenges both for the region and for Europe’s security architecture through a contagion effect.

AI.tldr: 欧盟是巴尔干地区稳定的唯一可行长期选择，但犹豫不决和条件限制可能造成地缘政治真空，被破坏性力量填补。需要欧盟采取更坚定、结果导向的扩大进程战略承诺。

AI.findings: 欧盟虽然是该地区稳定的唯一可行长期选择，但当前的犹豫和条件限制可能创造地缘政治真空；巴尔干地区可能在相对平静和结构性不稳定之间摇摆

It highlights how sustainable development objectives link economic, environmental, and biotechnological policies, shaping regulations and incentives for global agriculture, health, and innovation.

title: International Trade and Environmental Protection: Reconciling Competing Interests under the WTO Law
affiliations: Jadara University

detail.title: International Trade and Environmental Protection: Reconciling Competing Interests under the WTO Law

declarations.ethicsApproval: yes

detail.abstract: This paper models the impact of environmental regulations on international trade flows within the framework of the World Trade Organization (WTO) law. With the aim of reconciling the competing interests of trade liberalization and environmental protection, this study analyzes how stringent environmental policies affect bilateral trade among countries. An augmented gravity model of international trade is employed, incorporating environmental regulation indices into the traditional gravity equation. The model utilizes hypothetical data from 10 countries, including variables such as GDP, distance, and environmental regulation indices ranging from 1--10. Ordinary least squares (OLS) regression is used to estimate the coefficients of the model. The results indicate that larger economies and shorter distances positively influence trade flows, which is consistent with traditional gravity models. Importantly, stricter environmental regulations are significantly associated with reduced trade. Specifically, the environmental regulation indices have negative coefficients (−0.150 for exporting countries and −0.120 for importing countries), suggesting that greater regulatory stringency hinders trade competitiveness under WTO law. The paper underscores the need for policymakers to design environmental regulations that protect the environment without unnecessarily impeding international trade. Harmonization of environmental standards and international cooperation are recommended to balance trade and environmental objectives within the WTO framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究在WTO法律框架下分析了环境法规对国际贸易流量的影响，发现更严格的环境法规会显著减少贸易流量，建议政策制定者设计既能保护环境又不阻碍贸易的法规。
AI.research_question: 环境法规如何影响WTO法律框架下的国际贸易流量？
AI.motivation: 协调贸易自由化与环境保护之间的竞争利益，分析严格环境政策对双边贸易的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: WTO法律框架下的国际贸易理论，重力模型理论
AI.method: 采用扩展的重力模型，将环境法规指数纳入传统重力方程，使用10个国家的假设数据，包括GDP、距离和环境法规指数（1-10），采用OLS回归估计模型系数。
AI.findings: 较大经济体和较短距离对贸易流量有正向影响；更严格的环境法规显著减少贸易（出口国环境法规指数系数-0.150，进口国-0.120）。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统重力模型，将环境法规因素纳入国际贸易分析框架，为WTO法律框架下的贸易与环境关系研究提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议设计平衡环境保护和贸易自由化的环境法规，推荐环境标准协调和国际合作。

title: Law In The Tax Legal System, Income Inequality And Economic Growth: An Empirical Estimation

detail.title: Law In The Tax Legal System, Income Inequality And Economic Growth: An Empirical Estimation
detail.abstract: The law on the tax system is of great interest when we discuss income inequality and economic growth. The understanding and interpretation of the purpose of taxes are closely related to the rule of the role of the state as the expansion of the role of the state increases the need for monetary means by which the state meets public needs and which in itself constitute public revenues (Bardho, 2022). This study aims to highlight the impact of income inequality and economic growth in the case of North Macedonia. The distribution of income and the average level of income in a developing country is the key factor for social wellbeing. Countries, where income inequality is decreasing, grow faster than those with rising inequality (OECD, 2014). The data used are time series data and cover the period 1997–2019. This study uses data from World Development Indicators (WDI) and sheds light on the factors, which impact income inequality using multiple regression analyses. This study employs the OLS regression analysis in order to estimate the variables that affect income inequality and economic growth. It is concluded that the positive Gini coefficient approves the Kuznets hypothesis and the proinequality theory which means that in the first phase of countries’ development, income inequality is expected to be positively linked to economic growth. The study suggests that economic growth, if the benefits of growth are evenly distributed, has a positive effect on reducing income inequality.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过OLS回归分析北马其顿1997-2019年数据，验证了库兹涅茨假说，发现经济发展初期收入不平等与经济增长正相关，但均衡分配的增长收益有助于减少不平等。
AI.research_question: 北马其顿的收入不平等与经济增长之间存在何种关系？税收制度如何影响这种关系？
AI.motivation: 收入分配和平均收入水平是发展中国家社会福祉的关键因素，国家角色扩张增加了对税收资金的需求，需要理解税收目的与收入不平等的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 库兹涅茨假说、亲不平等理论、税收制度理论
AI.method: 使用世界发展指标(WDI)的时间序列数据(1997-2019年)，采用OLS多元回归分析方法
AI.findings: 正向的基尼系数支持库兹涅茨假说，表明国家发展初期收入不平等与经济增长正相关；经济增长收益均衡分配对减少不平等有积极作用
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了库兹涅茨假说在转型经济体北马其顿的适用性，为亲不平等理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为北马其顿政策制定者提供了税收政策和收入分配改革的实证依据，强调经济增长收益均衡分配的重要性

detail.title: Transnational Mass Tort Litigation: A Proposal for an International Court of Civil Justice

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston Univ. School of Law Research Paper No. 25-26
publicationDetails.journalName: Boston University School of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This chapter will present an argument for the creation of an International Court of Civil Justice to hear transnational mass tort cases. It will consider some of the challenges of adjudicating cross-border mass torts, along with the incentives and feasibility of a new international court to adjudicate these claims. Drawing upon a number of case studies, including the Bhopal disaster, litigation surrounding the devastation of the Ecuadorian Rain Forest, and the attempts to sue over human rights abuses in Nigeria, the chapter will show that the world's legal systems were not designed to solve these kinds of complex transnational disputes, and the absence of mechanisms to ensure coordination means that victims try, but fail, to find justice in country after country, court after court. The chapter also explains how an ICCJ would provide victims with access to justice and corporate defendants with a non-corrupt forum and an end to the cost and uncertainty of unending litigation-more efficiently resolving the most complicated types of civil litigation.

AI.research_question: 如何有效解决跨国大规模侵权案件的司法管辖和裁决问题？

title: Does Public Participation in Constitution-Making Strengthen Property Rights and Rule of Law?
affiliations: Texas Tech University - Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics and Texas Tech University - Rawls College of Business

detail.title: Does Public Participation in Constitution-Making Strengthen Property Rights and Rule of Law?
detail.abstract: Can public participation in Constitution-making strengthen property rights and rule of law? Since 1990, most new Constitutions have been ratified via referenda and participation in earlier stages has become increasingly prevalent. Participation fosters coordination among citizens, raises constitutional awareness, and enables citizenry enforcement of a generality norm, likely strengthening property rights and rule of law. Bologna Pavlik and Young (2025b) find participation increases Constitutional compliance in provisions specific to property rights. Yet, whether participation improves de facto quality of such rights is unclear. We employ participation data from Eisenstadt et al. (2015, 2017a) and measures of property rights and rule of law from Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) (Coppedge et al. 2025). We define new Constitutional adoptions with significant participation as treatments; adoptions without are counterfactuals. Using event studies and matching methods, we find that participation, particularly in the convening stage, increases all measures of property rights and rule of law.

AI.findings: 参与（特别是在召集阶段）提高了所有财产权和法治的衡量指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了公众参与宪法制定对制度建设的理论机制，为民主制度设计提供了理论支持。

title: Why Bad Law Persists: Evolutionary Stable Strategies in Legal Systems

detail.title: Why Bad Law Persists: Evolutionary Stable Strategies in Legal Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. The author has no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involves theoretical analysis and publicly available legal documents only.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. This research was conducted independently.

detail.abstract:
This paper applies the concept of Evolutionary Stable Strategies (ESS), developed by Maynard Smith and Price (1973) and popularized by Dawkins (1976), to explain the persistence of inefficient, suboptimal, or seemingly irrational legal arrangements.

Unlike previous evolutionary theories of law that failed by treating legal rules as organisms subject to natural selection, we demonstrate that certain legal configurations persist because they constitute ESS-strategies that, once adopted by a sufficient proportion of actors, cannot be displaced by alternative strategies.

Through game-theoretic modeling and empirical evidence from Argentine legal history, we identify three primary legal ESS: precedent systems that self-reinforce through path dependency, informal influence networks that create participation incentives preventing reform, and theatrical compliance that satisfies formal requirements while preserving substantive deviations.

Our analysis reveals that legal ESS exhibit the key mathematical properties identified by Maynard Smith, functioning as Nash equilibria that remain stable against invasion by mutant strategies. This framework explains why certain suboptimal laws persist despite their social costs and why legal reforms often fail unless they account for the underlying strategic equilibrium.
The paper concludes by identifying conditions under which legal ESS can be disrupted and replaced, offering practical insights for legal reform efforts that acknowledge strategic realities rather than assuming rational legal evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文应用进化稳定策略（ESS）理论解释低效法律安排的持续性，通过博弈论模型和阿根廷法律史实证，识别了三种法律ESS类型，揭示了为何次优法律能够长期存在以及法律改革失败的原因。
AI.research_question: 为什么低效、次优或看似非理性的法律安排能够长期持续存在？
AI.motivation: 传统法律进化理论将法律规则视为受自然选择的有机体，这种解释存在缺陷，需要新的理论框架来解释法律安排的持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化稳定策略（ESS）理论，由Maynard Smith和Price提出，Dawkins推广，结合博弈论中的纳什均衡概念。
AI.method: 博弈论建模和阿根廷法律历史的实证证据分析。
AI.findings: 识别了三种主要的法律ESS：通过路径依赖自我强化的先例系统、创造参与激励阻止改革的非正式影响网络、以及满足形式要求但保留实质偏差的戏剧性合规。这些ESS具有数学稳定性，能够抵抗突变策略的入侵。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESS理论成功应用于法律领域，提供了新的理论框架来解释法律安排的持续性，弥补了传统法律进化理论的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 确定了法律ESS可以被破坏和替代的条件，为法律改革提供了实用见解，强调需要考虑战略现实而非假设理性的法律进化。

detail.title: Exploring Pathways to the Scaling of Post-Growth Enterprise: The Case of a Food Co-op – Tenant’s Union Alliance

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-02529

detail.abstract: This article explores the conditions under which post-growth economic alternatives can scale and increase their transformative potential. Building on debates about Marxist political economy, commons theory and social reproduction theory, we suggest that while existing literature often emphasizes internal institutional design, the capacity of these alternatives to expand is equally shaped by external conditions and cross-sectoral alliances. Based on action research, we examine the design, implementation and outcomes of an experimental alliance between a food cooperative and a tenants’ union in Prague, Czech Republic. We argue that this alliance contributes to the scaling of the post-growth enterprise in at least three ways: by expanding the cooperative’s membership and lowering barriers to participation, by introducing more accessible and collective forms of shopping and consumption and by fostering the circulation of practical knowledge and political solidarity across the domains of food and housing. The case underscores the strategic relevance of linking “constructive” and “confrontational” forms of organizing to resist capitalist pressures and foster more resilient, value-circulating commons ecologies. Rather than relying on cultural change or isolated entrepreneurial efforts, we advocate for embedded, coalition-based strategies that acknowledge the historical and systemic constraints shaping economic alternatives.

detail.abstract: At its core, antimonopoly is a governing philosophy. It views concentrations of power as a threat to freedom, recognizing that tyranny comes in many guises. And it recognizes that securing democratic checks against this power is vital for securing real freedom for people—freedom from the arbitrary exercise of coercive power, as well as the freedom to build a life of one’s choosing.

detail.abstract: As far back as Independence, agriculture has contributed a significant amount to the development of the economy. During the financial year 1950-1951, agriculture accounted for 59% of the country's total GDP. While the agriculture sector has been declining, (17.8% of the GDP for the year 2019-20), it still plays an important role in the Indian economy and 54.6% of the total workforce is engaged in agricultural and allied sector activities (Census 2011) and accounts for Given the importance of the agriculture sector, the Government of India has taken several steps for its development in a sustainable manner. Steps have been taken to improve the income of farmers. The present paper seeks to understand paddy crop production elasticity and returns to scale in the Warangal District in Telangana State. Paddy crop is grown both in the kharif and rabi seasons in the country. As for the agricultural ministry's advanced estimates for the Kharif session of 2022-23, India's Paddy production is likely to decline by 6% to 104.99 million tonnes in the Kharif session. Paddy cultivation in Telangana hit a new high this Yasangi crop season with the crop sown in nearly 54 lakh acres, a staggering increase of 160 percent when compared to the season's normal cultivation area of 33.53 lakh acres. Paddy was cultivated on 64.54 lakh acres during Vaanakalam (Kharif) season of 2022-23 and 35.84 lakh acres during the Yasangi season of 2021-22.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度Warangal地区水稻生产的弹性系数和规模报酬，发现该地区水稻生产呈现规模报酬递增特征，为农业政策制定提供了实证依据。

AI.method: 采用计量经济学方法，通过生产函数模型分析Warangal地区水稻生产数据，估计各生产要素的产出弹性并计算规模报酬。

title: From Paper to Code: Are Cryptocurrencies Reshaping the Future of Money?

detail.title: From Paper to Code: Are Cryptocurrencies Reshaping the Future of Money?
detail.abstract: The rapid evolution of blockchain technology has led to the emergence of cryptocurrencies as a potential alternative to traditional fiat currencies. Process virtualization theory (PVT) and Tokenomics Theory are two vital models used for the study. This research explores the viability of cryptocurrencies becoming the world's new form of currency by examining their fundamental features, advantages, and limitations. A pilot study was conducted on sample size of 20 with the help of a survey method. On the basis of analysis, we found out that regulatory challenges, volatility, security concerns, and societal acceptance are main factors that influence the mainstream adoption of digital currency.It also highlights that while awareness and interest in cryptocurrencies are growing, significant barriers remain to their widespread adoption as a global currency .We the authors confirm that the study is free from plagiarism and stands original.

title: PSPFlow: Bayesian Inverse Design of Process–Structure–Property Linkages via Flow-Based Generative Models
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Georgia Institute of Technology - School of Computational Science and Engineering, , Georgia Institute of Technology, Georgia Institute of Technology - School of Computational Science and Engineering and Georgia Institute of Technology - George W. Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering

detail.title: PSPFlow: Bayesian Inverse Design of Process–Structure–Property Linkages via Flow-Based Generative Models
detail.abstract: Inverse problems are central to material design. While numerous studies have focused on designing microstructures by inverting structure--property linkages for various material systems, such efforts stop short of providing realizable paths to manufacture such structures. Accomplishing the dual task of designing a microstructure and a feasible manufacturing pathway to achieve a target property requires inverting the complete process--structure--property linkage. However, this inversion is complicated by a variety of challenges such as inherent microstructure stochasticity, high-dimensionality, and ill-conditioning of the inversion. In this work, we propose a Bayesian framework leveraging a lightweight flow-based generative approach for the stochastic inversion of the complete process--structure--property linkage. This inversion identifies a posterior distribution in the processing parameter space, where utilizing these processing conditions realizes materials with the desired target properties. Our modular framework readily incorporates the output of stochastic forward models as conditioning variables for a flow-based generative model, thereby learning the complete joint distribution over processing parameters and properties. We demonstrate its application to the multi-objective task of designing processing routes of heterogeneous materials given the target set of bulk elastic moduli and thermal conductivities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于贝叶斯框架的轻量级流生成方法，用于随机反演完整的工艺-结构-性能联系，解决了材料设计中同时设计微观结构和可行制造路径的双重任务挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何通过反演完整的工艺-结构-性能联系，同时设计材料微观结构和可行的制造路径以实现目标性能？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多只关注通过反演结构-性能联系来设计微观结构，但缺乏提供实际制造这些结构的可行路径的方法。实现同时设计微观结构和制造路径需要反演完整的工艺-结构-性能联系，这面临着微观结构随机性、高维度和反演不适定性等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯框架结合流生成模型，利用随机前向模型的输出作为条件变量，学习处理参数和性能的完整联合分布。
AI.method: 采用轻量级流生成方法进行随机反演，构建处理参数空间的后验分布，通过模块化框架整合随机前向模型输出。
AI.findings: 该方法能够识别处理参数空间的后验分布，利用这些处理条件可以制造出具有所需目标性能的材料。在多目标设计异质材料加工路径的应用中表现出色。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的贝叶斯框架来解决工艺-结构-性能联系的反演问题，为材料设计提供了理论基础和方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的制造路径设计工具，能够同时优化材料性能和制造可行性，特别适用于多目标异质材料设计场景，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Bridging Attitudes and Policy: Stakeholder Preferences for AI Integration in U.S. Hybrid K-12 Education
affiliations: Kennesaw State University - Department of Economics and Finance, Kennesaw State University - Michael J. Coles College of Business, Kennesaw State University - Michael J. Coles College of Business, Kennesaw State University - Michael J. Coles College of Business, Auburn University and Auburn University

detail.title: Bridging Attitudes and Policy: Stakeholder Preferences for AI Integration in U.S. Hybrid K-12 Education
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into K-12 education, hybrid and microschooling environments present both opportunities and challenges for responsible implementation. This paper examines stakeholder preferences for AI use policies through a nationally distributed survey and a conjoint experiment targeting school leaders, teachers, and parents from hybrid schools in the United States. We find broad support for tightly regulated student-facing AI applications-particularly for low-stakes tasks like tutoring or brainstorming-and cautious openness to teacherfacing tools. However, significant misalignment exists across stakeholder roles: while school leaders express greater enthusiasm for AI integration, teachers and parents adopt more guarded stances. Our findings underscore the importance of co-designing AI policy by incorporating perspectives from all key stakeholders and by tailoring rules to specific educational tasks. The study further offers practical insights to guide school leaders in developing responsible, stakeholder-aligned AI policies within hybrid learning contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过全国调查和联合实验发现，混合学校中不同利益相关者对AI教育应用政策存在显著差异：学校领导者更支持AI整合，而教师和家长态度更谨慎。研究强调需要共同设计AI政策，整合所有关键利益相关者观点，并针对具体教育任务制定规则。
AI.research_question: 混合学校和微型学校环境中，不同利益相关者（学校领导者、教师、家长）对AI使用政策的偏好是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在K-12教育中的日益普及，混合和微型学校教育环境为负责任地实施AI提供了机遇和挑战，需要了解各利益相关者的政策偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、教育技术采纳理论、政策制定理论
AI.method: 全国分布调查和联合实验，针对美国混合学校的学校领导者、教师和家长
AI.findings: 广泛支持严格监管的学生端AI应用（特别是低风险任务如辅导和头脑风暴），对教师端工具持谨慎开放态度；不同利益相关者角色间存在显著不对齐：学校领导者对AI整合更热情，教师和家长态度更保守
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对教育环境中AI政策偏好的理解，揭示了利益相关者角色差异对AI采纳态度的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校领导者制定负责任、利益相关者一致的AI政策提供实用指导，强调共同设计和任务定制化规则的重要性

reference: European Labour Law Journal, Special Issue: Protecting Platform Workers in the European Union, Online first, 2025
title: The Collective Rights Dimension of the Platform Work Directive: Assessing Regulatory Effectiveness in the Digital Labour Context
affiliations: ETUI

detail.title: The Collective Rights Dimension of the Platform Work Directive: Assessing Regulatory Effectiveness in the Digital Labour Context

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Labour Law Journal, Special Issue: Protecting Platform Workers in the European Union, Online first, 2025

detail.abstract: This article examines the collective labour rights dimension of the EU Platform Work Directive (PWD), drawing on a normative framework centred on personal scope, material scope, and enforcement. The analysis shows that while the Directive represents a milestone in regulating employment status and algorithmic management, its ability to rebalance bargaining power remains uncertain. The PWD makes progress by extending key rights related to automated monitoring and decision-making systems to all "persons performing platform work," including the self-employed. However, consultation rights remain limited to employees, leaving selfemployed workers with more limited prerogatives. The Directive also falls short in addressing subcontracting practices that separate platforms' economic power from legal accountability, thereby weakening meaningful collective engagement. In addition, although pioneering rights concerning algorithmic management and data use are introduced, their implications for core working conditions such as wages and working time are largely overlooked. By contrast, the enforcement dimension emerges as comparatively stronger, granting workers' representatives a more active role. The article concludes by outlining policy options-including stricter rules on subcontracting, a directive on algorithmic management at work, and greater attention to labour market power-to reinforce collective labour rights in a digitalized economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟平台工作指令在集体劳动权利方面的成就与局限，指出该指令在就业身份认定和算法管理方面具有里程碑意义，但在重新平衡议价能力方面效果不确定，特别是在分包实践和核心工作条件方面存在不足。
AI.research_question: 欧盟平台工作指令在集体劳动权利方面的规制效果如何？其在个人范围、实质范围和执行三个维度上的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济的发展，平台工作模式对传统劳动法体系构成挑战，需要评估欧盟平台工作指令在保护集体劳动权利方面的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于个人范围、实质范围和执行的规范性分析框架，评估集体劳动权利的实现程度。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析和政策评估方法，对欧盟平台工作指令的条款进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 1）指令在算法管理和数据使用方面开创了重要权利；2）但协商权利仅限于雇员，自雇者权利有限；3）分包实践削弱了集体参与；4）对工资和工作时间等核心条件关注不足；5）执行机制相对较强。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了评估数字平台集体劳动权利的三维分析框架，为数字劳动权利研究提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了政策建议：加强分包监管、制定工作场所算法管理指令、关注劳动力市场权力不平衡问题，以强化数字化经济中的集体劳动权利。

title: Identification of High-Risk Expressway Segments Using Connected Vehicle Data: An Empirical Analysis
affiliations: Tongji University, Tongji University, Tongji University, University of Waterloo, Tongji University and Tongji University

detail.title: Identification of High-Risk Expressway Segments Using Connected Vehicle Data: An Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: Traditional road safety analysis primarily relies on historical crash data, which require long accumulation periods and are constrained by limitations such as insufficient data volume, imprecise location information, and underreporting, potentially leading to biased or delayed assessments of road safety risks. The emergence of connected vehicle (CV) technology provides new opportunities for more timely safety analysis. CVs are equipped with onboard sensors that monitor driving behavior and issue critical warnings, including headway monitoring warnings (HMWs) and forward collision warnings (FCWs). This study proposes an integrated framework for proactively identifying high-risk expressway segments using CV warning data and spatial autocorrelation analysis. Based on CV data from nine expressways in Shanghai, warning hotspots are identified using Moran’s I and Getis-Ord Gi*, indicating locations with spatial clustering of HMWs and FCWs. The relationship between warning frequency and the number of collisions is examined through regression models. To address the potential endogeneity between traffic conflicts and collisions, an instrumental variable Poisson model is employed. The results confirm that HMW and FCW frequencies are positively associated with collisions, and that accounting for endogeneity improves estimation robustness. In addition, hotspot co-occurrence analysis and statistical testing reveal that segments identified exclusively as CV warning hotspots still experience significantly more collisions compared to segments identified as neither warning nor collision hotspots. This suggests that CV warning data can support early detection of emerging safety risks. This study contributes a structured and empirically supported framework that advances the application of connected vehicle data in proactive traffic risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于网联车辆预警数据和空间自相关分析的集成框架，用于主动识别高速公路高风险路段。研究发现HMW和FCW预警频率与碰撞事故正相关，且仅被识别为预警热点的路段仍然比非热点路段发生更多碰撞，证明网联车辆数据可以支持早期安全风险检测。
AI.research_question: 如何利用网联车辆预警数据主动识别高速公路高风险路段？网联车辆预警数据与碰撞事故之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 传统道路安全分析依赖历史碰撞数据，存在数据积累周期长、数据量不足、位置信息不精确和漏报等问题，可能导致安全风险评估存在偏差或延迟。网联车辆技术为更及时的安全分析提供了新机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间自相关分析理论（Moran's I和Getis-Ord Gi*）、内生性处理理论（工具变量Poisson模型）、交通冲突理论与碰撞事故关系理论
AI.method: 基于上海9条高速公路的网联车辆数据，使用Moran's I和Getis-Ord Gi*识别预警热点，通过回归模型检验预警频率与碰撞次数的关系，采用工具变量Poisson模型处理内生性问题
AI.findings: HMW和FCW预警频率与碰撞事故正相关；考虑内生性提高了估计的稳健性；仅被识别为预警热点的路段比非热点路段发生更多碰撞事故
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理交通冲突与碰撞事故之间内生性的方法；建立了网联车辆预警数据与安全风险之间的理论联系；发展了基于空间自相关分析的风险识别框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理部门提供了基于网联车辆数据的主动安全风险评估框架；支持早期检测新兴安全风险；提高了道路安全管理的及时性和准确性

title: Throughout the Winters of our Discontent: A Synchronous Approach to the Reconstruction of Ukraine
affiliations: Amsterdam Center for International Law

detail.title: Throughout the Winters of our Discontent: A Synchronous Approach to the Reconstruction of Ukraine
detail.abstract:
The study starts from the premise that Ukraine’s reconstruction involves more than rebuilding the nation’s infrastructure in a post-war context, but is a process that begins during the war and involves the rise of Kyiv’s regional and global status as an integrated part of the Euro-Atlantic community. The reconstruction process must run in parallel with that of sending military aid. Among the sectors most affected by the war are agriculture and real estate, where considerable investment will be needed.

The analysis also describes the various ways in which reconstruction aid is being provided to Ukraine, be it through the involvement of international organisations or regional sharing of reconstruction between Ukraine’s allies in the form of ‘constructive competition’. At the same time, Ukraine’s neighbouring countries can play a key role, as Romania can be a real logistical hub for foreign companies involved in the reconstruction process.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰重建不仅是战后基础设施重建，更是在战争期间就开始的过程，涉及提升基辅作为欧洲-大西洋共同体一员的地区与全球地位。重建过程需与军事援助并行，农业和房地产是最需要投资的领域。国际组织和盟国间的'建设性竞争'是重建援助的主要方式，罗马尼亚等邻国可成为重要物流枢纽。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰重建过程中的战略定位、援助机制及关键领域投资需求是什么？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰重建不仅是战后恢复，更是在战争期间就开始的战略过程，涉及国家地位提升和区域一体化，需要与军事援助同步进行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战后重建理论、国际援助机制、区域一体化理论、地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 政策分析与案例研究，分析乌克兰重建的战略定位、援助渠道和关键投资领域
AI.findings: 1) 重建需与军事援助并行；2) 农业和房地产是最需投资领域；3) 国际组织和盟国间'建设性竞争'是主要援助方式；4) 邻国如罗马尼亚可成为重要物流枢纽
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了战后重建理论，提出'战时重建'概念，强调重建过程与军事行动的同步性，以及重建对国家地位提升的战略意义
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰重建提供战略框架，明确关键投资领域，建议国际援助机制和邻国协作模式，为政策制定者和投资者提供实践指导

title: Taking Standards Seriously: The Case for a Private Standards-Based Approach to AI Governance
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School and University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School

detail.title: Taking Standards Seriously: The Case for a Private Standards-Based Approach to AI Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Berk. Tech. L. J. (forthcoming Fall 2025)

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI) across industry verticals and other domains of social and economic life is forcing policymakers to confront an urgent challenge: how to govern AI systems effectively without stifling innovation or beneficial deployment. This Article argues that private standards-based governance--the adoption of voluntary consensus standards developed through open, multistakeholder processes--offers the most promising "second-best" approach in a world where practical constraints make ideal governance unattainable. Drawing from the successes of standards in governing past digital technologies, the Article highlights how private standards can serve as a regulatory modality for AI by embedding expectations and constraints directly into technological design and organizational practice. Through comparative institutional analysis, it demonstrates how standards-based governance outperforms traditional regulation across four key dimensions: governance architecture, technical expertise and inclusive participation, adaptability to rapid change, and global scalability. At the same time, the Article confronts a number of tradeoffs and challenges such as the non-binding nature of standards and their susceptibility to industry capture. These challenges and tradeoffs, however, can be managed more efficiently through thoughtful institutional design and strategic government support. The Article ultimately contends that, although standards are not a cure-all, they represent a vital opportunity to build a sustainable, responsive, and highly effective AI governance ecosystem-provided that stakeholders approach their development with the urgency and intentionality the moment demands.

AI.tldr: 本文主张基于私人标准的治理是AI监管的最有前景的"次优"方案，通过多利益相关方制定的自愿共识标准来平衡创新与监管需求。
AI.research_question: 在AI快速发展的背景下，如何通过私人标准制定来实现有效的AI治理，同时避免传统监管的局限性？
AI.motivation: AI技术的快速普及迫使政策制定者面临监管挑战：既要有效治理AI系统，又不能扼杀创新或有益部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较制度分析框架，借鉴过去数字技术标准治理的成功经验，分析标准作为监管模式的适用性。
AI.method: 采用比较制度分析方法，从治理架构、技术专长、适应性和全球可扩展性四个维度对比标准治理与传统监管的优劣。
AI.findings: 基于标准的治理在四个关键维度上优于传统监管，但面临标准非约束性和行业俘获等挑战，这些挑战可通过制度设计和政府支持来管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于私人标准的AI治理理论框架，为数字技术治理提供了新的理论视角和分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的AI治理实施路径，强调通过多利益相关方参与的标准制定过程来构建可持续、响应迅速的AI治理生态系统。

title: Lawyer Assignment with Congestion: Redesigning the Comal County Pilot Program
affiliations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, HSE University and University of Sydney

detail.title: Lawyer Assignment with Congestion: Redesigning the Comal County Pilot Program
detail.abstract: The American system of assigning public lawyers to indigent defendants relies on denying choice as a method of congestion management. An attempt to address the perceived unfairness of this system by allowing defendants to choose their lawyers in Comal County, Texas, led to overcrowding of the most popular lawyers. We propose the implementation of efficient and mobility-free assignments where no defendant prefers to unilaterally switch lawyers. We prove that such assignments always exist and, when feasible, coincide with the unique envyfree assignment. We demonstrate that while the mechanism deployed in the pilot program is obviously manipulable, no mobility-free mechanism is obviously manipulable. Under a mobility-free mechanism, any potential gain from individual manipulation is limited. We develop a class of congestion-cutting mechanisms ensuring efficient and mobility-free outcomes. Finally, we propose a practical design for assigning lawyers in places like Comal County that preserves choice while preventing overload, ensuring that any defendant who expresses a clear preference for less-congestion is never assigned to a lawyer with excessive caseload.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国公设辩护人分配系统中的拥堵管理问题，提出了无流动性分配机制，确保高效且无嫉妒的律师分配，同时防止个别律师过载。
AI.research_question: 如何在允许被告选择律师的同时，避免最受欢迎律师的过度拥堵，并实现高效公平的分配？
AI.motivation: 美国公设辩护人系统通过剥夺选择权来管理拥堵，这种做法被认为不公平。德克萨斯州科马尔县的试点项目允许被告选择律师，但导致了最受欢迎律师的过度拥挤。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于匹配理论和机制设计理论，特别是无流动性分配和嫉妒自由分配的概念。
AI.method: 理论证明和机制设计分析，包括存在性证明、可操作性分析以及拥堵削减机制的设计。
AI.findings: 无流动性分配总是存在，且在可行时与唯一的嫉妒自由分配重合；无流动性机制不会被明显操纵；个体操纵的潜在收益有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了无流动性分配的理论框架，证明了其存在性和与嫉妒自由分配的关系，发展了拥堵削减机制的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科马尔县等地区设计了实用的律师分配方案，既保留选择权又防止过载，确保偏好较少拥堵的被告不会被分配到案件过多的律师。

title: Institutional Framework for Improving Food Security in Crisis-Prone Areas in Indonesia
affiliations: Universitas Hasanuddin, Syiah Kuala University, Brawijaya University, Universitas Hasanuddin, Universitas Muhammadiyah Makassar and Universitas Hasanuddin

detail.title: Institutional Framework for Improving Food Security in Crisis-Prone Areas in Indonesia
detail.abstract: Food insecurity in disaster-prone regions of Indonesia represents a significant challenge for development and governance. This study applies Interpretative Structural Modelling (ISM) to map relationships among 19 Aceh, East Nusa Tenggara, and South Sulawesi institutions. The analysis highlights the central role of the National Food Agency, the Ministry of Agriculture, and Disaster Management Bodies, while community-based organizations provide legitimacy at the grassroots level.  The analysis produced hierarchical models of institutional influence and revealed critical constraints such as limited land access, infrastructure damage, and low institutional capacity. Strategic programmatic needs were also identified, including infrastructure rehabilitation, adaptive agricultural technologies, and community empowerment. The ISM framework facilitated the categorization of institutional objectives and potential systemic changes, emphasizing the importance of collaborative governance and localized decision-making. Findings reveal institutional constraints (land access, ecological limits, weak capacity) and identify strategic needs such as infrastructure rehabilitation, adaptive agriculture technologies, and community empowerment. The study offers a replicable framework for institutional mapping, contributing to governance and resilience-building strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用解释性结构模型分析印尼灾害多发地区的粮食不安全问题，识别出国家粮食机构、农业部和灾害管理机构的核心作用，以及社区组织在基层的合法性作用。研究发现制度约束（土地获取、生态限制、能力薄弱）和战略需求（基础设施重建、适应性农业技术、社区赋权），为治理和韧性建设提供了可复制的制度映射框架。
AI.research_question: 印尼灾害多发地区的粮食不安全问题中，各机构之间的关系网络和影响层次是怎样的？
AI.motivation: 灾害多发地区的粮食不安全是印尼发展和治理的重要挑战，需要理解各机构间的相互关系以制定有效的治理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 解释性结构模型（Interpretative Structural Modelling, ISM）
AI.method: 应用ISM方法对亚齐省、东努沙登加拉省和南苏拉威西省的19个机构进行关系映射分析
AI.findings: 1. 国家粮食机构、农业部和灾害管理机构发挥核心作用；2. 社区组织在基层提供合法性；3. 识别出制度约束：土地获取有限、基础设施损坏、制度能力低下；4. 战略需求包括基础设施重建、适应性农业技术和社区赋权
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可复制的制度映射分析框架，强调了协作治理和地方化决策的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼灾害多发地区的粮食安全治理和韧性建设提供了具体的战略建议和实施方案

detail.abstract:
This paper resolves a fundamental paradox in legal evolution: how self-interested actors create and maintain cooperative legal orders without centralized enforcement. Drawing on Dawkins' analysis of biological altruism, we demonstrate that commercial law emerges through three mechanisms that parallel biological evolution: kin selection (generating trust networks in early merchant communities), reciprocal altruism (creating self-enforcing contracts and trade customs), and costly signaling (establishing reputational systems that enable anonymous exchange). 

Historical analysis of merchant law from ancient Mesopotamia through medieval Europe to modern international commerce reveals that cooperative legal orders consistently emerge through evolutionary pressures rather than sovereign imposition. 

The lex mercatoria, Jewish diamond merchants, Islamic hawala networks, and contemporary international arbitration all exhibit the same evolutionary pattern: cooperation emerges from iterated interactions among self-interested traders who develop legal norms as extended phenotypes of their survival strategies. We formalize these dynamics through evolutionary game theory, showing that legal cooperation represents an evolutionary stable strategy (ESS) under conditions of repeated interaction, reputation tracking, and network exclusion. 

The paper challenges both Hobbesian assumptions about the necessity of sovereign enforcement and romantic notions about merchant virtue, demonstrating instead that commercial law represents an extended phenotype of human reciprocal altruism. 

These findings explain why commercial law shows remarkable consistency across cultures and millennia, why merchant communities resist state intervention in their dispute resolution, and why reputational sanctions often exceed legal penalties in effectiveness. 

The implications extend beyond commercial law to any legal domain where repeated interactions among identifiable actors create conditions for reciprocal altruism to evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文通过生物学演化理论解释了自利行为体如何在没有中央强制力的情况下创建和维护合作性法律秩序，揭示了商法通过亲缘选择、互惠利他和代价信号三种机制演化发展，挑战了霍布斯式主权强制必要性的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 自利的行动者如何在缺乏中央强制力的情况下创建和维持合作性法律秩序？
AI.motivation: 解决法律演化中的一个根本悖论：自利行为体为何能够建立合作性法律秩序，而不需要中央强制机构的干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dawkins的生物利他主义分析，运用演化博弈论，提出法律合作是演化稳定策略(ESS)，借鉴亲缘选择、互惠利他和代价信号三种生物演化机制。
AI.method: 历史分析方法，考察从古代美索不达米亚到中世纪欧洲再到现代国际商业的商法发展历程，结合演化博弈论的形式化建模。
AI.findings: 合作性法律秩序通过演化压力而非主权强制产生；商法表现出跨文化和千年的显著一致性；声誉制裁往往比法律惩罚更有效；商人社区抵制国家干预其争议解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战霍布斯关于主权强制必要性的假设和商人美德的浪漫观念；提出法律合作是人类互惠利他主义的扩展表型；为法律演化提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了为什么商人社区抵制国家干预；说明了声誉机制在法律执行中的重要性；为国际商事仲裁和跨境交易提供了理论指导；可应用于任何存在重复互动的法律领域。

title: Impact of USD-INR Currency Volatility on Nifty Sector

detail.title: Impact of USD-INR Currency Volatility on Nifty Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: “No potential conflict of interest was reported by the author.”
declarations.ethicsApproval: “This study did not involve human participants, medical data, or clinical trials, and therefore did not require ethics approval.”
declarations.funderStatement: no

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of USD-INR exchange rate volatility on the performance of selected NIFTY sector indices, providing a sector-wise perspective that has been largely overlooked in prior research. Using daily and monthly data from January 2020 to May 2025, the research applies advanced econometric methods, including Correlation Analysis, Vector Autoregression (VAR), Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) modelling, and Granger Causality testing, to analyze the dynamic relationship between currency fluctuations and sectoral stock movements. Five sectors FMCG, Automobile, Information Technology, Pharmaceuticals, and Media were selected based on their correlation coefficients with the USD-INR rate, ensuring coverage of high-, medium-, and low-sensitivity groups. Results reveal that while correlation values vary significantly across sectors, VAR impulse response functions and Granger causality tests indicate no statistically significant direct predictive impact of USD-INR shocks on these sectors over the studied period. GARCH modelling confirms volatility clustering in the USD-INR series, with major spikes during the COVID-19 pandemic (2020), global inflationary pressures (2022), and recent economic adjustments (late 2025), yet sectoral indices remained largely insulated due to factors such as domestic demand resilience, effective hedging strategies, and long-term contractual revenue structures. The findings suggest that macroeconomic and sector-specific fundamentals rather than short-term currency movements were the dominant drivers of sectoral performance during this period. This nuanced, time-sensitive analysis offers valuable insights for investors, policymakers, and financial advisors, emphasizing the importance of focusing on sectoral fundamentals and policy measures rather than relying solely on currency volatility as an investment signal.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了美元-印度卢比汇率波动对NIFTY行业指数表现的影响，发现虽然汇率存在波动聚集现象，但VAR和格兰杰因果检验显示汇率冲击对这些行业没有显著预测作用，行业表现主要受基本面和政策因素驱动。
AI.research_question: 美元-印度卢比汇率波动如何影响NIFTY行业指数的表现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍忽视了汇率波动对不同行业的差异化影响，需要从行业层面提供更细致的分析视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率波动与股票市场关系的理论框架，包括汇率传递效应、风险溢价理论和市场有效性假说
AI.method: 使用相关分析、向量自回归(VAR)、广义自回归条件异方差(GARCH)建模和格兰杰因果检验等计量经济学方法
AI.findings: 各行业与汇率的相关性差异显著，但VAR脉冲响应和格兰杰因果检验显示汇率冲击对行业指数没有统计显著的预测作用；GARCH模型确认汇率存在波动聚集，但行业指数因国内需求韧性、有效对冲策略和长期合同收入结构等因素而保持相对独立
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了汇率波动对行业层面影响的实证证据，挑战了汇率波动直接影响所有股票市场的传统观点，强调了行业异质性的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和金融顾问提供实用见解，强调应关注行业基本面和政策措施而非单纯依赖汇率波动作为投资信号

title: The Turkish Commercial Agent's Goodwill Indemnity and its Derogability in German-Turkish Legal Relations (Originally Published in German (RIW 2011, p. 125 ff.)
affiliations: Kadir Has University

detail.title: The Turkish Commercial Agent's Goodwill Indemnity and its Derogability in German-Turkish Legal Relations (Originally Published in German (RIW 2011, p. 125 ff.)

keywords: Non-derogable rights in commercial agency law

detail.abstract:
This article was first published in German in 2011 (Ausgleichsanspruch des türkischen Handelsvertreters und dessen Abdingbarkeit im deutsch-türkischen Rechtsverkehr


RIW 2011, 125 ff. ) The present version is an English translation and adaptation, updated with an introductory note on subsequent legal developments, in particular the enactment of Article 122 of the Turkish Commercial Code (TTK), which now expressly regulates the commercial agent’s goodwill indemnity.


This article examines the legal framework of the goodwill indemnity (denkleştirme talebi) of commercial agents (acente) in Turkish law and its derogability in German-Turkish legal relations. When the article was first published in 2011 in German (RIW 2011, 125 ff.), the Turkish Commercial Code of 1957 (Law No. 6762) did not provide a general statutory right to goodwill indemnity comparable to Section 89b of the German Commercial Code (HGB) or Article 418u of the Swiss Code of Obligations. The claim existed only for insurance agents under the Insurance Law and was otherwise developed through the case law of the Turkish Court of Cassation.

The article analyzes whether German entrepreneurs could validly exclude the indemnity in contracts with Turkish commercial agents by invoking Section 92c HGB and a choice of German law. It argues that, despite such contractual exclusions, Turkish courts would most likely uphold the agent’s right to indemnity as a matter of mandatory law and Turkish ordre public. Conversely, German courts would be inclined to enforce exclusions under Section 92c HGB, creating a conflict of approaches with significant implications for German-Turkish trade relations.

Since the entry into force of the new Turkish Commercial Code (Law No. 6102) in 2012, Article 122 TTK now expressly regulates the goodwill indemnity, closely aligning Turkish law with European standards. The updated provision introduces a comprehensive statutory framework that protects commercial agents and extends, by analogy, to other long-term distribution agreements such as dealership or franchise contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文分析土耳其商法中商业代理人的商誉补偿请求权及其在德土法律关系中可否被排除的问题。2011年首次发表时土耳其商法尚无一般性法定补偿权，主要依赖判例法。文章探讨德国企业能否通过选择德国法律有效排除该请求权，认为土耳其法院很可能会基于强制性法律和公共秩序维持代理人的权利，而德国法院则倾向于执行排除条款，造成法律冲突。2012年新土耳其商法典第122条明确规定了商誉补偿，使土耳其法律与欧洲标准接轨。
AI.research_question: 德国企业能否在与土耳其商业代理人的合同中通过选择德国法律和援引德国商法典第92c条有效排除商誉补偿请求权？
AI.motivation: 德土贸易关系中商业代理合同的法律不确定性，特别是商誉补偿请求权在不同法域的可排除性问题，对双边贸易有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际私法中的法律选择规则、强制性法律规定、公共秩序保留原则、比较商法分析。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、判例法研究、比较法分析、法律解释方法。
AI.findings: 土耳其法院很可能将商誉补偿请求权视为强制性法律而维持代理人权利，德国法院则倾向于执行合同排除条款，导致法律冲突；2012年新土耳其商法典第122条明确了该权利的保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对跨国商业代理关系中强制性法律规定和公共秩序保留的理解，为国际商法中的法律冲突研究提供了案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德土贸易中的商业代理合同起草提供法律指导，帮助企业了解在不同法域可能面临的法律风险和处理策略。

title: Creditor Rights and Investment Efficiency in Financially Distressed Firms
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management, Udaipur, Saint Louis University - Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business, University of Oklahoma - Michael F. Price College of Business and Indian Institute of Management Udaipur

detail.title: Creditor Rights and Investment Efficiency in Financially Distressed Firms
detail.abstract: Do strong creditor rights in bankruptcy law improve the efficiency of investments in financially distressed firms? Exploiting a landmark insolvency resolution reform, we find that strengthening creditor-control rights improves the investment efficiency of financially distressed firms compared to non-distressed firms by reducing their overinvestment. Further, stronger creditor rights are more effective in improving the investment efficiency of firms with higher personal costs of bankruptcy of shareholders and less disciplined managers. Fear of sub-optimal liquidation, loss of control over the firm, and management turnover in the event of insolvency in a regime with stronger creditor rights incentivizes managers and shareholders of distressed firms to utilize resources more efficiently. These results provide robust evidence on the economic mechanisms via which bankruptcy laws can address agency problems in principal-agent models with information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，加强破产法中的债权人控制权能提高财务困境企业的投资效率，主要通过减少过度投资来实现。债权人权利越强，对股东破产个人成本较高和管理层约束较弱的企业效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 破产法中强大的债权人权利是否能提高财务困境企业的投资效率？
AI.motivation: 探讨破产法改革如何通过改善债权人权利来解决信息不对称下的代理问题，提高资源配置效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托-代理理论和信息不对称理论，分析债权人权利对管理层和股东行为的激励效应。
AI.method: 利用一项具有里程碑意义的破产解决改革作为自然实验，比较财务困境企业与非困境企业的投资效率变化。
AI.findings: 加强债权人控制权显著提高了财务困境企业的投资效率，减少了过度投资；对股东破产个人成本较高和管理层约束较弱的企业效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为破产法如何通过经济机制解决委托-代理问题提供了稳健证据，深化了对债权人权利作用机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的破产法律制度提供了实证依据，有助于改善企业治理和资源配置效率。

title: Frictions in News Consumption: Evidence from Social Media
affiliations: Bocconi University, Tel Aviv University - Eitan Berglas School of Economics and Hebrew University of Jerusalem

detail.title: Frictions in News Consumption: Evidence from Social Media

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was approved by the Ethics Committees of Bocconi University (EA000764), Tel-Aviv University (0004305), and Hebrew University (IRB 2024 113).
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for this project was provided by the European Research Council (ERC Grant 101116966), the Israel Science Foundation, the Tel Aviv University Center for AI & Data Science (TAD), the Pinchas Sapir Center for Development, and the Foerder Institute for Economic Studies.

detail.abstract: We document pervasive frictions in news consumption on social media, and test interventions designed to address them through a large field experiment on Facebook. We find that a simple, platform-integrated interface prompting active choice significantly and persistently reduces the partisan slant of users' Facebook news portfolios, while coupling this interface with information substantially improves portfolio reliability. Our interventions also increase alignment between users' stated preferences and their Facebook portfolios and influence off-platform news consumption. The results underscore the promise of simple, behaviorally-informed, and scalable interventions to improve news consumption on social media platforms.

AI.tldr: 通过Facebook大型实地实验发现，简单的平台集成界面提示主动选择能显著持续减少用户新闻组合的党派偏见，结合信息提示还能提高新闻可靠性，这些干预措施能改善用户偏好与实际消费的一致性并影响平台外新闻消费
AI.research_question: 社交媒体新闻消费中存在哪些摩擦？如何通过行为干预措施改善用户在社交媒体上的新闻消费质量？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为主要新闻来源，但存在信息茧房、党派偏见和低质量新闻消费等问题，需要寻找简单可扩展的干预方法来改善新闻消费生态
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、选择架构理论、新闻消费行为理论
AI.method: 在Facebook平台上进行的大型实地实验，测试两种干预措施：1）平台集成界面提示主动选择；2）结合信息提示的干预
AI.findings: 1）简单界面提示能显著持续减少新闻组合党派偏见；2）结合信息提示能提高新闻可靠性；3）干预措施改善用户偏好与实际消费一致性；4）影响扩展到平台外新闻消费
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了行为干预在改善新闻消费质量方面的有效性，为选择架构理论在数字媒体环境中的应用提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台提供了简单、可扩展的行为干预方案，有助于改善平台新闻生态和用户信息消费质量

title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Convergence in Eastern and Northern Europe: Economic Transition and Policy Effectiveness
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Convergence in Eastern and Northern Europe: Economic Transition and Policy Effectiveness

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-02803

detail.abstract: This study investigates the convergence of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions between two structurally distinct European regions: Eastern Europe, consisting of transition economies, and Northern Europe, composed of advanced economies. The analysis employs panel regressions (fixed effects and 2SLS), including interaction variables to capture the complex relationships among the examined factors.The results highlight significant regional disparities. In both clusters, GDP growth is positively correlated with GHG emissions, confirming the persistence of scale effects and contradicting the assumption of automatic decoupling in developed economies. Energy productivity systematically reduces emissions in both regions, underlining the universal role of efficiency. A strong synergistic effect is also observed between renewable energy use and improvements in energy productivity, amplifying emission reductions. However, differences emerge in the effectiveness of renewable integration and environmental taxation: while these instruments reduce emissions effectively in Nordic countries, their impact in Eastern economies is weaker or even counterproductive, reflecting lower institutional capacity and slower technological adoption.The paper makes an original contribution to the literature on ecological economics by demonstrating the heterogeneous effectiveness of climate policies between advanced and transition economies. It also provides practical recommendations for designing European strategies tailored to the specific institutional and developmental contexts of each region.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过面板回归分析发现，东欧转型经济体与北欧发达经济体在温室气体排放收敛性上存在显著差异。GDP增长与排放正相关，能源效率普遍有效，但可再生能源整合和环境税政策在发达经济体更有效，在转型经济体效果较弱甚至适得其反。
AI.research_question: 东欧转型经济体与北欧发达经济体在温室气体排放收敛性方面存在怎样的差异？气候政策在不同类型经济体中的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 研究欧洲不同结构区域（转型经济体vs发达经济体）在温室气体排放收敛性方面的差异，以及气候政策在不同制度背景下的有效性差异，为制定针对性气候政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态经济学理论，环境库兹涅茨曲线理论，制度经济学理论，技术扩散理论
AI.method: 面板回归分析（固定效应模型和两阶段最小二乘法2SLS），包含交互变量以捕捉复杂关系
AI.findings: 1）两地区GDP增长均与温室气体排放正相关，证实规模效应持续存在；2）能源生产率在两地区均能系统性减少排放；3）可再生能源使用与能源生产率改进存在强协同效应；4）可再生能源整合和环境税在 Nordic国家有效，但在东欧经济体效果较弱甚至适得其反
AI.theory_contributions: 为生态经济学文献做出原创贡献，证明了气候政策在发达经济体与转型经济体之间的异质性有效性，丰富了制度背景对政策效果影响的理论认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计针对欧洲不同地区特定制度和发展背景的定制化战略提供实践建议，强调了政策设计需要考虑区域制度能力和技术采纳速度的差异

title: Sources of Variation in Pharmaceutical Registration Fees
affiliations: University of Ghana - College of Health Sciences

detail.title: Sources of Variation in Pharmaceutical Registration Fees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nor applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No external research funding was used in support of this paper.

detail.abstract: National regulatory authorities (NRAs) in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs) need a steady stream of financing for pre-and post-market-entry regulation. Identifying options for funding NRA functions, however, provides no guidance or indication as to what the optimal level of fees is or should be. An examination of how registration fees vary from country to country will help determine whether current or proposed fee structures or levels are appropriate. This paper seeks to investigate the sources of variation in pharmaceutical registration fees. It finds that fees vary with stringent regulatory authority status, the intensity of health R&D, government share of total healthcare expenditures and universal health coverage indices, besides the commonly cited relationship with gross domestic product (per capita) and total healthcare expenditures (per capita). For efficiency and effectiveness, fees in LMICs must be set and revised to reflect changes in these variables with adequate attention given to building a supportive environment (where there is rule-of-law, control of corruption, government effectiveness, positive regulation quality, and political stability) for NRAs to effectively perform all core functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中低收入国家药品注册费用的变化来源，发现费用差异与监管机构严格程度、健康研发强度、政府医疗支出占比和全民医保指数等因素相关，建议费用设置应考虑这些变量并建立支持性监管环境。
AI.research_question: 药品注册费用的变化来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 中低收入国家的国家监管机构需要稳定的资金支持，但目前缺乏关于最优收费水平的指导，需要研究各国注册费用的差异来确定合适的收费结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学、公共财政理论、医疗体系融资理论
AI.method: 跨国比较分析，考察不同国家药品注册费用的变化模式和相关因素
AI.findings: 药品注册费用差异与严格监管机构地位、健康研发强度、政府医疗支出占比、全民医保指数、人均GDP和人均医疗总支出等因素相关
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对监管费用决定因素的理解，超越了传统经济指标，纳入了制度环境和医疗体系特征因素
AI.practical_contributions: 为中低收入国家制定和调整药品注册费用提供了实证依据，强调需要建立法治、控制腐败、政府效能等支持性环境来确保监管机构有效运作

title: An Anatomy of the International Financial System Vis-À-Vis the Human Body System
affiliations: George Washington University - School of Business

detail.title: An Anatomy of the International Financial System Vis-À-Vis the Human Body System
detail.abstract:
This paper attempts to construct an anatomical structure around key constituents in the International Financial System (“IFS”) in comparison with anatomical features of the human body. The IFS is a conglomeration of financial systems, encompassing financial and monetary activities, that are so intertwined that the fragility of a system, affects the stability of the IFS. Similarly, the human body system is a compendium of sub-systems working together to ensure the body functions effectively. The human body and IFS are both products of a complicated intertwined formation of sub-systems. Thus, analogies are made between the structure and functions of key constituents in the IFS, and vital organs and components in seven (7) systems of the human body; circulatory, respiratory, digestive, nervous, skeletal, integumentary, and respiratory systems.

The contextual structure of this paper is twofold: (1) making analogies between constituents of the IFS and components of the human body system, (2) positing supporting evidence to the analogies through occurrences from select global financial crises, and a global pandemic. The global financial crises are: The Great Depression (1929-1939), The International Debt Crisis (1982-1989), The Asian Financial Crisis (1997-1999), and The Great Recession (2007-2009). The global pandemic is the COVID-19 pandemic (2019-till date).

title: Economic and Financial Solutions for Biodiversity Conservation
affiliations: Chongqing University, Chongqing University, Chongqing University, Independent, Trinity Business School, Trinity College Dublin, University of Groningen - Center for Energy and Environmental Sciences (IVEM) and Chongqing University - School of Economy and Business Administration

detail.title: Economic and Financial Solutions for Biodiversity Conservation
detail.abstract: Economic and financial instruments have been widely applied in biodiversity conservation, from payments for ecosystem services to green bonds, from biodiversity offsets to Nature Positive frameworks-these market-based mechanisms continue to innovate and expand. However, despite the continuous growth in funding scale and instrument diversity, global biodiversity continues to decline at an accelerating pace. This paper systematically analyzes the operational mechanisms and implementation outcomes of major conservation instruments, finding that their widespread failure stems from fundamental contradictions between market logic and ecosystem characteristics. These contradictions manifest in three aspects: ecological values cannot be fully monetized, ecological losses are often irreversible, and the market's demand for short-term returns conflicts with the long-term processes of ecological restoration. Facing the limitations of traditional instruments, emerging global frameworks such as Nature Positive, while offering conceptual innovations, perpetuate the inherent deficiencies of marketbased approaches. In light of this, this paper proposes systematic reform pathways, including value pluralization, incentive mechanism restructuring, spatiotemporal scale integration, democratization of power relations, and economic model transformation, emphasizing that transcending market-based thinking is key to achieving effective conservation.

title: The Evolution of Trumpism: Economic Policy Shifts from the 45th to the 47th Presidency in the Shadow of Biden's Legacy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Evolution of Trumpism: Economic Policy Shifts from the 45th to the 47th Presidency in the Shadow of Biden's Legacy
detail.abstract: This paper examines the transformation of Donald Trump's economic policies between his first term (2017-2021) and his second term (2025-present), with a particular focus on how Joe Biden's presidency (2021-2025) served as a pivotal catalyst for change. Drawing on economic data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) and Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), as well as analyses from institutions like the Tax Foundation and Penn Wharton Budget Model, the study highlights Biden's inflation crisis-peaking at 9.1% in 2022-as a key factor enabling Trump's bolder approach in 2025. While Trump's core principles of tax reduction, deregulation, and protectionism remain consistent, his second term features amplified tariffs (10-20% universal, 60% on China) that function as demand-suppressing mechanisms, contributing to stabilized inflation around 2.4% by mid-2025. Comparative analysis reveals a shift from experimental policies in the 45th presidency to more aggressive, less constrained actions in the 47th, facilitated by Republican congressional control and public disillusionment with Biden's fiscal overreach. The paper argues that this evolution reflects broader populist responses to post-pandemic economic anxieties, with implications for future U.S. fiscal stability and global trade. Findings suggest Trump's tariffs may yield short-term revenue gains ($93.9 billion by June 2025) but risk long-term GDP reductions (up to 6%), underscoring the tension between protectionism and growth.

title: Changing the Paradigm for Central Banking: Female Role Models in Male-Dominated Fields
affiliations: Michigan State University and Michigan State University

detail.title: Changing the Paradigm for Central Banking: Female Role Models in Male-Dominated Fields
detail.abstract: Central banking has historically been male-dominated. Few women held leadership roles in central banking until recently, and the profession's sine qua non of leadership attributes-inflation aversion-is male-coded in the public imagination. Research shows that, as a result, the women who do become central bankers encounter gender-incongruence costs in the form of reduced public support. What might ameliorate those costs? We propose that female role models can do so by shifting social expectations of central banking's implicit "maleness," and thus improving how the public perceives female central bankers. Knowing about one female central banker improves people's perceptions of others. We test our theory using survey experiments in the eurozone that randomly attribute central bank communication to male and female central bankers. Our findings show that European respondents who are aware of female central bank leaders respond more favorably to communications attributed to other, less prominent female central bankers that we presented to them.

While the agriculture sector has been declining, (17.8% of the GDP for the year 2019-20), it still plays an important role in the Indian economy and 54.6% of the total workforce is engaged in agricultural and allied sector activities (Census 2011) and accounts for Given the importance of the agriculture sector, the Government of India has taken several steps for its development in a sustainable manner. Steps have been taken to improve the income of farmers. The present paper seeks to understand paddy crop production elasticity and returns to scale in the Warangal District in Telangana State. Paddy crop is grown both in the kharif and rabi seasons in the country. detail.abstract: This paper investigates how the global dominance of the US dollar amplifies the cross-border transmission of financial shocks originating in the United States. I develop a small open economy DSGE model that embeds the dollar’s central role in international trade and finance and calibrate it to the Korean economy. Key parameters are estimated by matching impulse responses to a shock in the excess bond premium (EBP), a standard measure of US financial conditions. The analysis shows that two core functions of the dollar in global finance—the role of dollar-denominated bonds as safe assets and the dollar’s centrality in financing working capital for global supply chains—constitute the primary channels through which US financial shocks spill over internationally. Absent these mechanisms, the output losses from US financial shocks would be more than two-thirds smaller. Finally, the results suggest that shifting trade invoicing from the dollar to the domestic currency can significantly dampen these spillovers as well, lowering the output losses by roughly one-fourth.

title: Adaptation of Parental Benefit in Bangladesh: A Legal Perspective

detail.title: Adaptation of Parental Benefit in Bangladesh: A Legal Perspective
detail.abstract: In Bangladesh, more women become part of the job market every year and they frequently feel disadvantaged due to a lack of proper maternity leave regulations, which forces them to deal with the majority of parenting obligations, particularly when fathers cannot remain at home, as well as a lack of waged parental or paternal leave. Social inclusion of men in terms of paternity benefit, let alone parental benefit has not been seen in both sociological and legal context in Bangladesh as the idea of splitting up child care responsibilities equally between father and mother is not supported by our patriarchal society. However, fathers who actively participate in parenting, can make a persistent, beneficial impact on their children's life. Thus, Bangladesh should adopt the paternity leave law, just like other nations have, for the sake of the mother and the child. Hence, this paper by employing qualitative method of study will explore the legal framework for possible adaptation of parental benefit. For that purpose, this paper will bring to light a different dynamic of parental benefit exploring the conceptual framework in both inclusive of male and female. Lastly, this paper will particularly assess a comparative study of legal accepts of different South Asian countries to find out the best practice which can be a recommendation for the policy makers.

detail.abstract:
Russia’s invasion of Ukraine altered the structure and the fundamentals of post-Cold War security architecture. In more than one sense, it appeared unequivocally that few things shall remain untarnished in matters pertaining to the order of state-to-state interactions or the (crumbling) self-desired universality of international law. But such a metamorphosis of perception did not limit to issues of high politics, military doctrine or legal responsibility in times of war.

Simultaneously with Russia’s terrestrial deployment of large-scale destruction upon its neighbor, a naval blockade was instituted, effectively sealing all of Ukraine’s (remaining) Black Sea ports from their commerce with the wider world. More than 20 tons of agricultural products – headed for export – remained grounded in the docks and inland silos, unable to reach global markets. Then followed a systematic campaign of incapacitating Ukraine’s grain-producing sector: dismantling of infrastructure, theft of stocked harvests, removal of equipment and industrial hardware.

The whole world witnessed Russia’s (ab)use of famine as a threat aimed not merely at Ukraine, but to the entire array of Kyiv’s customers overseas. And, in this sense, the present study will proceed by explaining the two actors’ centrality and relevance in the global food supply chains. Further on, it will address the manner in which the war changed both their positions and those of regular overseas customers, leading to a race to buy and stock on a disrupted market. In the final parts, the short- and medium-term solutions to the crisis will be analyzed, struggling to glimpse the new ‘horizon’ of food supply and the larger global market in the aftermath of the blockade.

With or without the blockade, a significant part of the transnational agricultural export capacity had been affected by Russia’s invasion, proving that wars (and their subsequent effects) cannot be ‘grounded’ and ‘isolated’. What happens in Ukraine, might not stay in Ukraine, but provoke hunger across the other side of the globe.

detail.title: Determinants of adherence to the Payment for Environmental Services (PES) Programs in the DRC

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-02741

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the determinants of rural Congolese households' adherence to Payment for Environmental Services (PES) programs through two contrasting cases: PIREDD Kwilu, a "top-down" provincial program, and SACKEN in Kingakati, a "bottom-up" community initiative. Based on a survey of 549 households, supplemented by interviews and focus groups, it uses econometric models (Probit, IV-Probit, Heckman, IVREG2) to correct for endogeneity and selection biases.The results first indicate that, paradoxically, high dependence on forest resources discourages participation in the absence of economic alternatives. On the other hand, targeted awareness-raising, secure land titles and payment levels are essential levers for offsetting the opportunity cost of unsustainable practices. Local institutional anchoring, measured by participation in community work, agricultural seniority and indigenous membership, significantly reinforces the effectiveness of incentives, especially in the case of SACKEN.The heterogeneity of effects reveals that forest dependency results in an increase in membership of the "bottom-up" model, while PIREDD membership figures remain lower. Furthermore, factors such as levels of formal education and gender-moderated participation differ according to the governance scale, with a quarter of households perceiving no benefit at all. The major obstacles are late payment, inadequate input quality and distribution, reduced farmland and insufficient social support. To guarantee take-up, it is recommended to calibrate PES schemes according to the level of forest dependency, to adapt communication to educational and gender profiles, and to rely on community networks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比刚果农村地区两种PES项目（自上而下的PIREDD Kwilu和自下而上的SACKEN），分析了549户家庭的参与决定因素。研究发现森林依赖度高的家庭反而不愿参与，而定向宣传、土地产权安全和适当支付水平是关键激励因素。社区制度嵌入显著提升激励效果，不同治理模式存在异质性效应。

detail.title: Weather Shocks and Sectoral Dynamics in European Economies
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic effects of weather shocks on economic activity in Europe's three largest economies: Germany, France, and Italy. We develop a novel approach to measuring country-level exposure to abnormal weather, based on grid-level data weighted by economic activity. We construct five harmonized weather indices-heat, cold, drought, precipitation, and wind-and, using a Bayesian SVAR framework, assess their impact on output and prices across major sectors: energy, construction, manufacturing, and services. The results show that weather shocks have both direct and indirect effects on economic activity, with substantial heterogeneity across shock types and production sectors.

detail.abstract: ﻿ ﻿This paper estimates the impact of type 2 diabetes on mortality among obese adults in the United States, addressing a key gap in the economics of chronic illness. Leveraging nationally representative data from the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) linked to mortality records, we apply double machine learning to estimate the marginal impact of diabetes conditional on obesity. Results indicate that among obese individuals, diabetes increases the probability of all-cause mortality. Subgroup analyses show that this risk is especially pronounced among males, adults aged 60 to 74, individuals with hypertension, and those employed in physically demanding or public-sector occupations. A policy-relevant calculation suggests that for every 29 obese adults who avoid or delay the onset of diabetes, one premature death could be prevented. A random forest algorithm analysis highlights insurance status, educational attainment, and poverty level as dominant predictors of mortality risk, reinforcing the importance of social and economic context in shaping health outcomes.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working paper

detail.abstract: Current application of US antitrust law is at odds with common sense. The US v Google LLC decision provides a prime example. Apple extracts billions of dollars annually from Google, yet antitrust agencies and courts identify Google as the monopolist. The reason for this error lies in the underdeveloped state of monopoly maintenance doctrine. Following Microsoft, the law allows plaintiffs to charge dominant firms with violations of Section 2 of the Sherman Act for conduct responsive to monopoly power exploitation by a trading partner. Section 2 law thus supports liability findings against dominant firms that pay exorbitant prices to a monopolist based on the argument that they get a competitive advantage in return. To address this flaw, a market power utilization requirement must be rehabilitated to prevent antitrust law from being systematically misdirected against the wrong firms.
