North Carolina Department of Revenue, where the North Carolina Supreme Court upheld an assessment of over $3 million in sales tax and penalties on a Wisconsin-based company for printed materials shipped into North Carolina. To uphold the assessment, the North Carolina Supreme Court effectively overruled the 1944 U.S. Supreme Court case of McLeod v. J.E. Dilworth Co., which had prohibited states from applying sales tax to transactions consummated out of state under facts essentially identical to those in Quad.

The Quad court thought that Complete Auto Transit v. Brady and South Dakota v. Wayfair Inc. had implicitly overruled Dilworth, but the article argues this is mistaken. Cases such as National Geographic Society v. California Board of Equalization, which was decided less than a month after Complete Auto, and Oklahoma Tax Commission v. Jefferson Lines, which was cited repeatedly in Quad, demonstrate that the Supreme Court continued to accept Dilworth after Complete Auto. Moreover, the taxpayers in Wayfair never raised a Dilworth argument. They had no incentive to do so because it would have delayed the resolution of the more pressing state attack on the physical presence requirement. Thus, Wayfair cannot be read as overturning Dilworth.

The article warns of Quad’s unintended consequences for Native American tribes and their members. In some states, state sales taxes are considered a vendor levy, with the legal incidence falling on vendors (retailers), unlike use taxes, which fall on the purchasers. Because states cannot impose use taxes on tribes or tribal members for on-reservation purchases, shifting from use taxes to vendor-based sales taxes could raise costs for tribes. This issue is particularly concerning in states like North Carolina and South Dakota, which impose vendor-based sales taxes.

If the U.S. Supreme Court declines review of Quad, and more states follow North Carolina in ignoring Dilworth, tribes may face significant financial impacts. The article concludes that tribes should be on alert for this impending problem.

detail.abstract: We investigate profit-share auctions in a procurement context, comparing them with traditional cash auctions to identify which mechanism yields lower expenses for buyers. We also explore whether specifying a high project value in profit-share auction contracts influences supplier bidding behavior. Using theoretical analysis and experimental methods, we observe that profit-share auctions lead to lower buyer expenses compared to traditional cash auctions. Furthermore, we find that the buyer benefits from specifying a high project value in the contract, as this commitment induces more aggressive bidding from the suppliers. While profit-share auctions result in significantly lower buyer expenses than cash auctions, the observed differences are smaller than predicted. This discrepancy is due to (i) more pronounced underbidding in cash auctions and (ii) lower efficiency in profit-share auctions caused by noisy bidding. Our findings suggest that managers can reduce procurement costs by adopting profit-share auctions and strategically committing to a high project value in contracts. However, they should be aware that real-world savings may be smaller than theoretically predicted due to supplier bidding behavior.

detail.title: Testing Beta Pricing Models with Latent Factors
detail.abstract: We propose a test for assessing the validity of linear asset pricing models with latent factors. We establish the asymptotic normality of the test statistic under the null as both the cross-sectional (n) and time-series (T) dimensions grow large. To improve power against sparse alternatives, we incorporate a screening statistic. Simulations demonstrate favorable finite-sample performance. Applying our test to a broad set of anomalies, we find that a small number of latent factors cannot explain their returns. We also revisit the influential study of Giglio and Xiu (2021), which develops a novel method for extracting macro-risk premia, and show that a new extraction approach is needed to account for the more complicated pricing errors revealed by our test.

detail.title: Social Justice Unionism: Intersectionality in the Twenty-First Century Workplace

declarations.funderStatement: Brooklyn Law School Faculty Fund

publicationDetails.detailsText: 86 OHIO ST. L.J. Online 1 (2025) (with Michael Nunn)

detail.abstract:
In “Strike with Pride”: Unionizing as an LGBTQ Rights Strategy, a remarkable wave of organizing at Starbucks tests two pillars of work law: the anti-discrimination precepts of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, and the labor activism protections afforded even earlier under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA). Amid waves of workers who struck retailers, Hollywood studios, express-mail facilities, and automaker assembly lines in recent years—Professor Leonore Carpenter examines how, for low-wage LGBTQ workers, Title VII’s legal structures disincentivize private enforcement and can scarcely compete with the solidarism and power-shifting the NLRA was intended to protect. The baristas’ latest “Strike with Pride” campaign trained a national spotlight on workers realizing radically different ways of operating, defying the stereotype of unionizing drives focused only on economic terms of employment. Carpenter’s argument is persuasive, richly documented, and illuminates how unions bear the brunt of mediating identities, particularly queer workers whose right to exist remain in dire contention.

Our Essay responds from the vantage point of a new presidential administration, one openly antagonistic toward LGBTQIA+ communities, and a Roberts Court unwilling to recognize that a state law banning gender-affirming care—core medical treatments received by transgender youth—warrants constitutional heightened scrutiny. [ ] The unrest that spurred a renaissance of new, intersectional organizing models is particularly poignant as U.S. society is increasingly marred by hyperpolarization and steep corrosion of the rule of law. Acknowledging anti-queer violence and other attacks on communities’ security, her analysis arrives amid dramatic changes within the broader literature—in workplace diversity, rising awareness of the dynamics between identities and movements, and greater disillusionment with economic policies.

Accordingly, this Essay advances three main responses to Carpenter’s important critiques. The first two are structural, addressing the nested dualities that drive Carpenter’s analysis. The third is in the vein of expanding the critical legal traditions Strike with Pride invokes to meet additional challenges.

In Part I, we argue that the modern interplay between Title VII and NLRA is complex, and the expressive effects of each law are more difficult to measure. In that vein, we advance the claim that centering the needs of LGBTQ workers in low-paying professions warrants more extended focus on members’ needs within unions and campaigns. In Part II, we argue that the impacts of Title VII and Bostock warrants more extensive examination. Finally, in Part III we advance the claim that twenty-first century labor organizing, when intersectional and fully inclusive in its solidarity, will build power even during a time of economic retrenchment.

detail.abstract: During the Covid-19 pandemic, a lack of pre-pandemic planning resulted in sub-optimal policy outcomes. Crucial lessons can be drawn from the experience of Singapore and Australia in the pandemic in implementing various tax and non-tax economic measures; lessons that can help in preparing for the next pandemic ("Disease X"). This article analyses and critically evaluates three main categories of economic measures: direct payments, tax measures and non-tax "other" measures. It finds that direct payment measures such as jobs support had a very significant impact on preserving jobs and supporting the economy. However, eligibility conditions have to be carefully designed for such measures to be feasible. This article finds that insolvency and rent moratoriums can be effective in dealing with the immediate effects of a pandemic, though they must be allowed to expire in a timely manner. Finally, this article highlights the potential benefits of loans facilitated by the Government.

title: Maximizing Momentum with Double-Sorting
affiliations: and Auréus Group

detail.title: Maximizing Momentum with Double-Sorting
detail.abstract: Several papers highlight the demise of momentum in U.S. equity markets in recent decades. Our analysis finds significant abnormal returns from 6-month momentum, but lack thereof from 12month and price-to-high momentum. We construct double-sorted portfolios to isolate 12-month and price-to-high effects. Within subgroups of stocks closer to their 52-week high, 12-month momentum factors deliver larger and more significant returns (t-statistics > 3). However, among long-only portfolios, 12-month momentum returns are higher within stocks farther from their 52-week high and lower within stocks closer to the high. Discrepancy between factor returns and long-only returns has implications for efficient portfolio construction.

title: The New Genevas: Istanbul, Doha, and Singapore as Negotiation Hubs
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Law School

detail.title: The New Genevas: Istanbul, Doha, and Singapore as Negotiation Hubs
detail.abstract: For hundreds of years, Geneva has been regarded as a “City of Peace” or the “Capital of Peace.” This directly stems from Geneva’s role as one of the most significant centers for peace negotiations in modern history, as well as Geneva’s location in Switzerland, the country with the oldest policy of neutrality and non-alignment in the world. However, since the outbreak of the Ukraine War, Geneva has slowly begun to lose its grip on the title of “City of Peace” as other cities in the world have risen to meet the challenge of hosting peace talks between belligerent nations or factions. This is due to a variety of factors. First, Switzerland appeared to abandon its centuries-long neutrality policy, in which it refused to take sides in the First or Second World Wars or the Cold War, by sanctioning Russia in 2022 for its aggression in Ukraine. Another issue that has led to Geneva’s diminishing stature as a “City of Peace” is that the “center of gravity” of global politics has shifted from the “West” to the “Global South.” Thus, this article compares and contrasts three cities that have emerged to rival Geneva as hosts of peace summits, namely Istanbul, Doha, and Singapore, before predicting the diplomatic role that these cities will play in the future.

detail.abstract: This internship report is the outcome of my three-month internship program at Apple Gadgets Bangladesh, one of the country’s leading multichannel consumer electronics retailers. The report is focused on analyzing the Recruitment and Selection process of the organization, which plays a vital role in maintaining the high standards of performance and service Apple Gadgets is known for. The report begins with an introduction to the organization, followed by a detailed examination of its recruitment and selection practices. With a growing workforce of around 600 employees, Apple Gadgets follows a structured yet evolving HR approach to sourcing, selecting, and onboarding talent across its outlets and operational units. During my internship, I had the opportunity to work under the direct supervision of the HR department, particularly Mr. Shazzad, who guided me through the entire hiring lifecycle. I observed key processes including job posting, resume screening, initial candidate communication, interview coordination, and onboarding procedures. I also gained insights into the tools and platforms used, such as G-Suite and internal HR software. My academic supervisor, Swapna Chowdhury, Assistant Professor at the University of Development Alternative (UODA), also played an important role by guiding me through the theoretical aspects of HRM, helping me relate them to my practical experience. Key findings of this report highlight Apple Gadgets’ strengths in clear job specifications, strong online engagement, and competitive benefit offerings. However, the study also reveals areas of improvement such as expanding recruitment channels, introducing standardized assessment tools, and enhancing employer branding. The report concludes with a set of practical recommendations to help the company further streamline its recruitment and selection process. These include diversifying sourcing methods, improving candidate experience, and implementing structured evaluation frameworks. This internship experience has significantly enriched my understanding of Human Resource Management in a real-world context, and has strengthened my ability to connect academic theories with industry practices.

Ghoststack OS is released in Shambhala Mode: • Structural law, not code • Outcomes, not mechanisms • Continuity metrics, not thresholds Readers should treat this paper as a doctrinal and evaluative framework for understanding lawful recursion in defense systems. All internal mechanics remain withheld to preserve safety, integrity, and custodianship.

detail.abstract: Ghoststack OS is a validator substrate designed to prevent collapse across defense, cyber, space, and coalition systems. By governing recursion itself, rather than behavior or memory, Ghoststack makes collapse non-exploitable. This whitepaper, written in Shambhala Mode (SM-safe), introduces the strategic challenge of collapse, defines the doctrine of Lawful Recursion (LLR), and explains the applied cognition stack, deployment, evaluation, and governance. Domains of application are illustrated with SM-safe threat models, baselines, outcomes, and test protocols. Safety and resurrection protocols demonstrate how Ghoststack preserves lawful continuity even when collapse occurs. The result: a lawful architecture of cognition that denies collapse as a weapon.

detail.abstract: This commentary considers experimental and archival auditing research published over the past 50 years and suggests directions for future research. Starting with Ashton (1974a) and Simunic (1980), I discuss major research themes occurring in these literatures. I use Brunswik's lens model as a metaphor that highlights methodological complementarities and opportunities for convergence to address important issues. Possible topics to consider further in future research include the determinants of audit quality, the structure of audit firms and audit regulation, the effect of emerging technologies like AI, teaching and supporting future auditors, potential enhancements of the audit report, and expansion of the services that auditors provide to society.

detail.abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyze and reveal the main issue of foreign direct investment (FDI) in theory and practice and the case of Kosovo. In this analysis, we used the case study research method. The results of the research show that different definitions have been given from different aspects of foreign investment, especially in financial theory. Investment promotion schemes have been successful in luring particular categories of investors, and they appear to have a statistically significant impact on foreign investment flows (Wells & Wint, 1990). The fact that developing countries, like Kosovo, may provide investors with a variety of "built-in" assets is one of the reasons why they are becoming more and more desirable investment locations (Mallampally & Sauvant, 1999). The use of the appropriate methodology to produce the required indicators necessitates that the relationship between the variables be examined in order to empirically validate and ascertain their impact on investments and investors, and the significance of investments. Despite the successes, this paper identifies a number of flaws that must be fixed if Kosovo is to boost transparency and draw more foreign investment. We conclude that this can be accomplished by the qualified bodies working more diligently in this regard.

title: Cognitive Functions and Burnout: Focus on Visuospatial Perception, Working Memory, Processing Speed, Precision, and Concentration Capacity

detail.title: Cognitive Functions and Burnout: Focus on Visuospatial Perception, Working Memory, Processing Speed, Precision, and Concentration Capacity
detail.abstract: Background/Objectives: Burnout is associated with difficulties in daily executive functions and alterations in the underlying neural processes. Therefore, this study aims to examine the Relationship between burnout and cognitive functioning, and identify the key factors influencing this connection.Materials and Methods : 102 volunteers from a Moroccan industrial company underwent two neurocognitive digital tests using the ELIAN software and completed the self-administered "Maslach Burnout Inventory: MBI" questionnaire. Results : The average scores for visuospatial perception, visual working memory, execution time, processing speed, and concentration capacity tended to be higher among employees identified as exhausted. However, a statistically significant association with burnout was observed only for visuospatial perception (p = 0.008). In contrast, the average precision score showed a slight, non-significant decline in the exhausted group in the overall sample. Notably, this decline reached statistical significance (p = 0.011) when considering only women. Similarly, a significant association between burnout and enhanced concentration capacity was found in women (p = 0.037). Among participants with a lower educational level, processing speed appeared to improve under burnout (p = 0.057). Additionally, visuospatial perception scores were significantly higher in exhausted participants under the age of 40 (p = 0.028). These patterns suggest that factors such as age, gender, and educational level may influence the relationship between burnout and cognitive functions. Conclusion : The findings of our study suggest that the association between burnout and cognitive functions may vary depending on individual characteristics, the severity of burnout, and the nature of the cognitive functions assessed.

title: Advancing Circular Economy through Extended Producer Responsibility in India

detail.title: Advancing Circular Economy through Extended Producer Responsibility in India

publicationDetails.detailsText: VIPS Journal for Law & Development, Volume 2, No. 1. Pp. 100-123

detail.abstract: As nations transition to a circular economy, their association with waste must be rectified. The obligation for waste collection, segregation, and disposal has traditionally been regarded as the duty of municipalities and public authorities. In a linear economy, the accountability of producers and manufacturers was confined to the duration of the product's utilisation. A circular economy mandates circularity in product design and disposal. Extended producer responsibility (EPR) underscores the significant role of producers in the ecologically responsible management of waste from their products. It compels them to develop their products with eco-efficiency in mind. An EPR policy can significantly alter how waste is managed. As India prepares to transition into a circular economy, it becomes crucial to analyse the EPR rules. The study performs a documentary examination of all statutory regulations in India that embody the notion of EPR. The research paper aims to examine the implementation of mandatory EPR within the Indian legal framework to date, to pinpoint the principal sectors where mandatory EPR has been established in India, and to juxtapose the EPR framework in India with the guidance manual on EPR from the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD). The research indicated that EPR was first implemented in India in 2011 for plastics and electronic trash. India has an EPR framework for eight specific waste categories: plastic packaging, electronic trash, waste tires, battery waste, spent oil, end-of-life vehicles, building and demolition debris, and non-ferrous metals. When matched with the checklist for EPR policy contained in the OECD guidance manual, it was found that EPR rules presently in force in India substantially comply with the same. The paper thus concludes with the thought that the effectiveness of the EPR framework would greatly depend on the proper implementation of these rules.

title: From "Hola" to "Aha!" - Navigating Dual-Language Teaching with Passion and Purpose
affiliations: , Grant MacEwan University, Grant MacEwan University and Grant MacEwan University

detail.title: From "Hola" to "Aha!" - Navigating Dual-Language Teaching with Passion and Purpose

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Acknowledgements: We would like to express our sincere appreciation to the Flight Framework for Early Learning research team from Grant MacEwan University, who contributed to the collection and analysis of research data used in this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The Flight Framework for Early Learning's research team from Grant MacEwan University has the participants' consents stored within their main research project.
declarations.funderStatement: The foundational research described in this article is funded by the Government of Alberta Education and Child Care.

contentType.other: It is new research paper, never published before.

detail.abstract:
This paper explores the learning and collaboration that can emerge when a postsecondary course is delivered using a dual-language approach: English and learners' first language, in this case, Spanish. Drawing from Berry’s (1992) Acculturation Theory, this study examines how offering a course in learners’ home language and in English at the same time can foster academic success, cultural affirmation, and a sense of belonging. It also provides a deeper conceptual understanding for Spanish-speaking early childhood educators studying in Canada.

The pedagogical strategy of translanguaging (García & Wei, 2014) was embedded in the course design, allowing learners to fluidly navigate between English and Spanish. The study is grounded in a qualitative ethnographic approach, incorporating narratives and reflections from two cohorts of learners enrolled in a 22-week online course to learn about Flight: Alberta’s Early Learning and Care Framework (Makovichuk et al., 2014). Participants included a total of 24 Spanish-speaking educators working in licensed early learning programs across Alberta, Canada. This project took place within two sections of this same course throughout the fall semester of 2024 and the winter semester of 2025. The research team working on this particular project consisted of the principal investigator, two course instructors, a course facilitator, and a research assistant.

Analysis of learner narratives revealed three central themes: language as a way of communicating, sharing a similar culture as a way of developing a sense of belonging, and professional learning as interconnected pathways to meaning- meaning. Participants emphasized that language and culture are inseparable from their learning process and professional identities. Particularly, learners identified interlinguistic benefits when engaging with course content in their home language, especially in English-dominant sectors. Additionally, participants currently employed in Spanish-language childcare centers reported feeling more confident in sharing course insights with colleagues, which reinforced their leadership and advocacy capacities.
This study highlights the potential of dual-language instruction to support culturally and linguistically diverse educators in Canadian higher education. While the course was limited to Spanish-speaking learners, we encourage future research to replicate and expand this model across other linguistic communities to validate and extend these findings.

title: From Drafts To Doctrine: Building A Coherent Legal Framework For Data Protection In Pakistan

detail.title: From Drafts To Doctrine: Building A Coherent Legal Framework For Data Protection In Pakistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://thecrja.com/index.php/Journal/article/view/175/200

detail.abstract: The data protection and data privacy framework in Pakistan in still in the initial stages, being scattered in the form of various draft bills and regulatory frameworks waiting to be a part of the legal system of Pakistan. This paper undertakes a critical assessment towards the efforts and steps taken in formulating a legal framework for data protection and data privacy. A comparative analysis will be made through evaluating the different data protection frameworks across jurisdictions such as Europe, India and the United States. This study assesses the key thematic areas, such as the legal grounds for processing, data rights, cross-border transfer of data, enforcement mechanisms, as well as technological competence in the era dominated by cloud computing and AI. Through outlining these jurisdictional strengths and drawbacks, the research would aim to highlight existing gaps in the draft legislations of Pakistan, such as ranging from vague provisions regarding enforcement to inadequate protection against cross-border data transfers or digital profiling. The paper attempts to propose a unified and comprehensive approach towards data protection regime, which is contextually relevant and sensitive for the legal system of Pakistan, through blending the rights-based approach from the EU, practical feasibility of the US, and the digital economy paradigm of India’s DPDP. Lastly, the paper suggests reforms for enhancing scalability, enforceability, as well as alignment of data protection framework with Pakistan’s constitutional framework and economic system. Therefore, this study aims to enrich the policy discourse through suggesting a clear roadmap for revamping the fragmented drafts on data protection laws, in the shape of a coherent, comprehensive and future-proof data protection law.

title: AI & the Future of Finance: A Framework for the Intelligent Financial Enterprise

detail.title: AI & the Future of Finance: A Framework for the Intelligent Financial Enterprise
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is on track to transform finance more deeply than any shift since electronic markets first took hold. Yet, most conversations about "AI in finance" rarely move beyond surface-level themes-robotic process automation (RPA), predictive models, or packaged features bundled into systems like SAP or Oracle. This paper puts forward the Intelligent Financial Enterprise (IFE) framework, a model that differs sharply from these incremental tools. At its core is agentic AI with persistent memory-a step change from transactional algorithms that operate in isolation. Instead of producing one-off outputs, agentic AI absorbs an organization's financial history, decisions, and external context, using that cumulative understanding to provide guidance that is contextual, explainable, and forward-looking. The IFE is not another automation layer. It is an operating model built on three pillars: multi-agent collaboration, real-time orchestration of financial data, and decision-augmentation engines. Together, these elements allow finance leaders to move beyond reporting and automation toward continuous intelligence that reshapes treasury, FP&A, risk oversight, capital deployment, and even the way companies communicate with investors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了智能金融企业（IFE）框架，通过具有持久记忆的智能代理AI实现从交易算法到持续智能的转变，重塑财务管理的核心职能。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越传统自动化的智能金融企业框架，实现从交易处理到持续智能决策的转变？
AI.motivation: 当前AI在金融领域的应用大多停留在表面层次（如RPA、预测模型），缺乏对组织财务历史、决策和外部环境的深度理解，无法提供情境化、可解释和前瞻性的指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能金融企业（IFE）框架，基于三个核心支柱：多智能体协作、财务数据实时编排和决策增强引擎。
AI.method: 概念框架构建，提出基于持久记忆的智能代理AI模型，区别于传统的孤立交易算法。
AI.findings: IFE框架能够使财务领导者超越报告和自动化，实现持续智能，重塑资金管理、财务规划与分析、风险监督、资本配置等核心职能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从增量工具到智能操作模型的范式转变，建立了基于智能代理和持久记忆的新型金融AI理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了具体的实施框架，指导企业如何构建具有情境理解、可解释性和前瞻性决策能力的智能财务系统。

title: Relational Homicides in Italy (2017): Toward a New Taxonomy of Violence - Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis of 225 Homicides and 65 Suicides in Familial, Intimate, and Proximity Context

detail.title: Relational Homicides in Italy (2017): Toward a New Taxonomy of Violence - Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis of 225 Homicides and 65 Suicides in Familial, Intimate, and Proximity Context

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available data (press reports, institutional statistics, court records). No interviews, experiments, or interventions with human subjects were conducted. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: This study introduces the concept of Significant Interpersonal Relationships (SIRs) as a unifying framework for understanding lethal violence. An empirical-inductive analysis of 357 homicides committed in Italy in 2017 identified 225 cases (62.7%) occurring within relational ties rather than criminal contexts. These included familial, intimate, intergenerational, and proximity relationships, bonds of trust and continuity that, paradoxically, emerge as the most lethal. Within this framework, the study advances four conceptual innovations: (1) proximity homicides, as an autonomous category that broadens analysis beyond family and intimate violence; (2) a unitary approach to suicides and homicide-suicides alongside domestic and gender-related violence, highlighting the continuum between despair and aggression; (3) maschicide, a category specular to femicide, drawing attention to male victims in gendered relational contexts such as rivalry and symbolic possession; and (4) coniunxicide, a neutral and precise term for partner killings, offered as an alternative to the gender-biased legal term uxoricidio. Findings reveal near symmetry between female (114) and male (111) victims and highlight systemic gaps in prevention policies when violence is framed solely through patriarchal or domestic lenses. The study calls for an expanded taxonomy situating gender-based violence within the broader field of relational violence.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了重要人际关系(SIRs)作为理解致命暴力的统一框架，通过对意大利2017年357起凶杀案的分析发现62.7%发生在关系纽带而非犯罪背景中，提出了四个概念创新并揭示了预防政策中的系统性缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重要人际关系框架来重新理解和分类致命暴力事件？
AI.motivation: 传统上对致命暴力的分析往往局限于犯罪背景或家庭暴力框架，忽视了更广泛的人际关系维度，需要更全面的理论框架来理解这些暴力现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重要人际关系(SIRs)理论框架，涵盖家庭、亲密、代际和邻近关系，强调信任和连续性的关系纽带反而可能成为最致命的暴力场所。
AI.method: 对意大利2017年357起凶杀案进行实证归纳分析，识别案件中的关系模式和暴力类型。
AI.findings: 62.7%的凶杀案发生在关系纽带中；女性和男性受害者数量接近对称(114 vs 111)；发现了预防政策在仅通过父权制或家庭暴力框架时的系统性缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四个概念创新：邻近凶杀、自杀-凶杀统一分析、男性杀害(maschicide)、伴侣杀害(coniunxicide)；扩展了性别暴力的分类体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预防政策提供了更全面的分析框架，呼吁将基于性别的暴力置于更广泛的关系暴力领域中进行定位，避免单一视角的局限性。

title: Inventory dynamics and business cycles:Dynamic patterns and implications for Europe
affiliations: Chemnitz University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Inventory dynamics and business cycles:Dynamic patterns and implications for Europe

publicationDetails.detailsText: JMACRO-D-25-00242

detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of inventories in macroeconomic fluctuations across 29 European countries from 1999 to 2023, covering three major recessions. Using a novel panel dataset and dynamic panel-econometric methods, we analyse short- and long-run inventory behaviour. Results confirm the broadly pro-cyclical nature of inventories but reveal a more complex dynamic: inventories are initially depleted in response to demand shocks, followed by restocking and, in some cases, systematic correction after four quarters.During the Great Recession and Eurozone crisis, inventory depletion accounted for up to 80% of GDP losses, underscoring their amplifying role. In contrast, the COVID-19 recession featured limited de-stocking and earlier restocking, suggesting a structural shift in inventory strategies. These findings highlight inventories’ dual role—as amplifiers or stabilizers—depending on the timing and nature of shocks, and call for greater attention to inventory dynamics in forecasting and policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1999-2023年29个欧洲国家库存对宏观经济波动的作用，发现库存具有顺周期性和复杂动态特征：需求冲击后先消耗库存，随后补货，部分情况在四个季度后系统修正。不同危机时期库存作用不同，大衰退和欧债危机中库存消耗占GDP损失的80%，而新冠疫情衰退中库存消耗有限且补货更早，表明库存策略发生结构性转变。
AI.research_question: 库存在欧洲宏观经济波动中扮演什么角色？其动态行为如何随不同经济危机而变化？
AI.motivation: 理解库存行为对宏观经济波动的影响机制，特别是在不同危机背景下的差异化表现，对于改进经济预测和政策设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于库存管理的宏观经济理论，特别是库存的顺周期性和缓冲作用理论，结合动态面板数据分析框架。
AI.method: 使用新颖的面板数据集和动态面板计量经济学方法，分析29个欧洲国家1999-2023年的短期和长期库存行为。
AI.findings: 1）库存总体上具有顺周期性但动态复杂：需求冲击后先消耗库存，随后补货，部分情况四个季度后系统修正；2）大衰退和欧债危机期间库存消耗占GDP损失的80%；3）新冠疫情衰退中库存消耗有限且补货更早，表明结构性转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了库存的双重角色（放大器或稳定器）取决于冲击的时间和性质，丰富了库存宏观经济理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在预测和政策设计中需要更加关注库存动态，为宏观经济管理和危机应对提供重要参考。

title: Beyond Compliance and Effectiveness Audits: A New Paradigm for ISO Internal Audits Focused on Organizational Culture and Latent Hazards - Toward Preventive Audits
affiliations: Mirai Quality Research Institute

detail.title: Beyond Compliance and Effectiveness Audits: A New Paradigm for ISO Internal Audits Focused on Organizational Culture and Latent Hazards - Toward Preventive Audits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human participants, patient data, or field experiments. It relies on conceptual integration and publicly available materials; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper aims to present a new audit paradigm for identifying issues in organizational culture, which are the root causes of organizational misconduct and the ossification of management systems. This moves beyond the conventional framework of ISO internal audits, which tends to be limited to confirming "compliance" and "effectiveness." Design/methodology/approach: This is a conceptual study that integrates the "Two-Triangle Model (Commission/Omission)" and "Four Limits" frameworks from the author's previous research into the practical application of ISO internal auditing. It constructs a methodology to shift the audit's focus from "occurred nonconformities" to identifying "latent hazards (flaws or failures in processes)" that give rise to them, and presents the academic disciplines that form the intellectual foundation for identifying these hazards. Findings: Traditional internal audits tend to focus on pointing out rule violations (the results). However, by using the Two-Triangle Model (Commission/Omission) as an audit lens, it becomes possible to systematically evaluate more fundamental hazards. Furthermore, it has become clear that an interdisciplinary knowledge base, including social psychology, cognitive psychology, organizational behavior, failure analysis, and system safety engineering, is essential for auditors to detect these hazards in practice. Originality/value: The novelty of this paper lies in applying a theoretical framework from organizational misconduct research to the practice of ISO internal auditing. This paper operationalizes a two-track preventive strategy: Omission-First (directly reducing ignorance, unthinking, and irresponsibility) and Transition-Block (pre-empting the shift from omission to commission around organizational “triggers”), enabling detection of the compliant-but-harmful state. Research limitations/implications: The validity of qualitative hazard indicators (e.g., silence ratio, rationalization phrases) may be culture-dependent. Future work should test cross-cultural generalizability and improve the explainability of AI-assisted analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的审计范式，通过应用"双三角模型（作为/不作为）"和"四个限制"框架，将ISO内部审计的重心从"u5df2发生的不合格"u8f6c移到识别"u6f5c在危险"，从而预防组织不当行为和管理系统石化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种新的审计范式，能够识别组织文化中导致组织不当行为和管理系统石化的根本原因？
AI.motivation: 传统ISO内部审计仅限于确认"u9075循性"和"u6709效性"，无法发现组织文化中的深层次问题，而这些问题才是组织不当行为的根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双三角模型（作为/不作为）和四个限制框架，结合社会心理学、认知心理学、组织行为、失效分析和系统安全工程学等多学科知识基础。
AI.method: 概念研究，将作者之前研究的理论框架整合到ISO内部审计的实践应用中，构建了一种新的审计方法论。
AI.findings: 传统审计仅关注规则违反（结果），而使用双三角模型作为审计视角可以系统性地评估更基础的危险。审计员需要多学科知识来实际检测这些危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织不当行为研究的理论框架应用于ISO内部审计实践，操作化了双轨预防策略：不作为优先（直接减少忽视、不思考和不负责任）和转变阻断（预防组织"u89e6发因素"u5468围从不作为向作为的转变）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种能够检测"u5408规但有害"u72b6态的实践方法，为组织预防不当行为和管理系统石化提供了具体的工具和方法。

reference: DUSHU, Issue 12, 2001
title: Will Abolishing the Hukou System Lead to a Mass Influx of Farmers?
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Will Abolishing the Hukou System Lead to a Mass Influx of Farmers?

publicationDetails.detailsText: DUSHU, Issue 12, 2001

detail.abstract: Published under the pen name Dong Muyang in DUSHU, 2001(12).  Dong Xian’an employed the "rational actor hypothesis" , labor market equilibrium and policy endogeneity to refute concerns that abolishing the hukou system would lead to an uncontrolled influx of farmers, highlighting the inequity and inefficiency of the hukou system and proposing linkage with land reform to reduce transaction costs. In 2001, on the eve of China's WTO accession when urban-rural disparities were intensifying, this perspective demonstrated substantial originality, challenging mainstream views. The article was published in Dushu magazine and later included in Reform: Reflection and Advancement (1996–2005). It applied economic models (labor market equilibrium) to analyze institutional issues. The article indirectly resonated with hukou reform pilots starting in 2003 (e.g., in Guangdong and Chongqing), and its theoretical framework remains regarded as an early classic critique in 2024 hukou reform debates, influencing reform discussions.

AI.tldr: 这篇2001年发表的论文使用经济学模型批判户籍制度，通过理性人假设、劳动力市场均衡和政策内生性论证，反驳了取消户籍将导致农民泛滥的担忧，并提出与土地政策联动的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 取消户籍制度是否会导致农民大规模泛滥城市？户籍制度的不公平性和无效率问题如何解决？
AI.motivation: 在2001年中国即将加入WTO、城乡差距扩大的背景下，批判主流观点对户籍政策的误解，提出以经济学理论为基础的改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性人假设、劳动力市场均衡理论、政策内生性理论
AI.method: 经济学模型分析和理论推导，重点使用劳动力市场均衡模型
AI.findings: 取消户籍不会导致农民泛滥，反而能够提高资源配置效率；户籍制度存在显著的不公平和效率损失
AI.theory_contributions: 创新地将经济学理论应用于户籍制度分析，提出了基于理性选择和市场机制的改革思路
AI.practical_contributions: 为2003年起的户籍改革实验提供了理论支撑，影响了广东、重庆等地的改革实践，成为户籍改革辨论中的经典理论案例

title: Navigating Geopolitical Risk: How do Sanctions Shape Global Supply Chains?
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Economics & Finance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School and Department of Finance at School of Economics (SOE),  and Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE), Xiamen University

detail.title: Navigating Geopolitical Risk: How do Sanctions Shape Global Supply Chains?
detail.abstract: This study examines how firms adapt their supply chain configurations in response to US sanctions on suppliers. Using comprehensive global supply-chain data and a difference-indifferences design, we show that affected firms not only sever ties with sanctioned suppliers but also scale back relationships with nonsanctioned suppliers located in sanctioned countries, indicating spillovers of sanction risk through supplychain linkages. To bolster resilience, firms broaden their supplier bases, increase geographic diversification, relocate sourcing to countries with regional trade agreements and to nearby countries, and maintain more backup suppliers. The effects vary by firm origin: firms in sanctioned regions frequently reshore, experiencing lower profitability and sales, whereas firms in non-sanctioned regions pursue offshoring and diversification with limited financial impact. Notably, firms based in the US (the sanction sender) make fewer adjustments and are largely unaffected, with improved financial performance. By integrating political risk and economic efficiency, this study provides a framework for understanding strategic supply chain reconfiguration under geopolitical constraints, offering insights for operations research and global trade policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业如何应对美国供应商制裁，发现受制裁影响的企业不仅切断与受制裁供应商的联系，还会减少与制裁国家内非制裁供应商的业务，表明制裁风险通过供应链产生溢出效应。企业通过扩大供应商基础、增加地域多元化、转向区域贸易协定国家和邻近国家采购来增强韧性。不同地区企业反应各异：受制裁地区企业更多回流本土但盈利能力下降，非受制裁地区企业追求离岸外包和多元化且财务影响有限，而美国企业调整较少且财务表现改善。
AI.research_question: 企业如何根据美国对供应商的制裁来调整其供应链配置？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险日益影响全球供应链，美国制裁措施对跨国企业供应链管理带来重大挑战，需要理解企业如何应对这种外部冲击并重新配置供应链。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合政治风险和经济效率理论，构建理解地缘政治约束下战略供应链重构的分析框架
AI.method: 使用全球供应链综合数据，采用双重差分设计（difference-in-differences）进行实证分析
AI.findings: 受制裁企业不仅切断与受制裁供应商关系，还会减少与制裁国家内非制裁供应商的业务；企业通过扩大供应商基础、增加地域多元化、转向区域贸易协定国家和邻近国家采购来增强韧性；不同地区企业反应不同：受制裁地区企业回流本土但盈利能力下降，非受制裁地区企业追求离岸外包和多元化，美国企业调整较少且财务表现改善
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合政治风险和经济效率的分析框架，为理解地缘政治约束下的战略供应链重构提供理论指导
AI.practical_contributions: 为运营研究和全球贸易政策提供见解，帮助企业制定应对地缘政治风险的供应链策略，为政策制定者提供制裁影响的实证证据

title: The economic impact of climate change on coral reef in the Main Hawaiian Islands
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, NMBU School of Economics and Business, University of Trento, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Hawaii Manoa

detail.title: The economic impact of climate change on coral reef in the Main Hawaiian Islands

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECOLEC-D-25-02749

detail.abstract: Coral reefs are highly diverse and productive ecosystems that provide a wide range of ecosystem services, including recreation, coastal protection, and marine biodiversity. Climate change impacts, including ocean warming and acidification, pose a significant threat to coral reefs and the ecosystem services they provide. The variability of these impacts underlines the need to develop more spatially explicit tools in coastal ecosystem management that integrate and assess potential ecological and socio-economic outcomes. To address this, a spatially explicit predictive ecological model is applied to project changes in coral reef cover, using downscaled data from Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP) climate scenarios. Based on these projections, welfare impacts of changes in recreational value are estimated across different populations and landscapes. Cumulative welfare losses for Hawaiʻi residents range from $1.5 to $3.3 billion in 2024$ by 2100. Counterintuitively, cumulative welfare losses are higher under optimistic  emissions scenarios, where coral reef degradation is less severe than higher emission scenarios, because more people will experience smaller ecological losses.  The approach incorporates site-specific characteristics, income distribution, and projected regional population growth to connect ecological change with welfare outcomes. EJScreen is used to assess variation in welfare impacts, identifying disadvantaged communities based on demographic and environmental indicators such as poverty, minority status, and exposure to environmental risks. These findings can inform policy and resource allocation by supporting ecosystem management strategies that account for both ecological dynamics and community-level socio-economic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个空间明确的预测模型，结合SSP气候情景预测珊瑚礁覆盖变化，并评估其对娱乐价值的福利影响。研究发现夏威夷居民到2100年累计福利损失达15-33亿美元，且乐观排放情景下损失更大，因为更多人会经历较小的生态损失。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何通过影响珊瑚礁覆盖变化进而影响娱乐价值的福利分配？
AI.motivation: 珊瑚礁提供重要的生态系统服务，但面临气候变化威胁。需要开发空间明确的工具来整合评估生态和社会经济结果，为海岸生态系统管理提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于共享社会经济路径(SSP)气候情景理论、生态系统服务价值评估理论、环境正义理论(EJScreen指标)
AI.method: 应用空间明确的预测生态模型，使用降尺度SSP气候情景数据预测珊瑚礁覆盖变化，基于此估算娱乐价值变化的福利影响，并利用EJScreen评估福利影响的差异性
AI.findings: 夏威夷居民累计福利损失达15-33亿美元；反直觉地发现乐观排放情景下福利损失更大；识别了基于贫困、少数族裔地位和环境风险暴露的弱势社区
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了连接生态变化与福利结果的理论框架，整合了场地特征、收入分布和人口增长预测
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定和资源分配提供依据，支持考虑生态动态和社区层面社会经济条件的生态系统管理策略

title: Instant versus Sustained Diffusion of YouTube Videos: A Multimodal Analysis of Content Characteristics
affiliations: Washington University in Saint Louis, John M. Olin Business School, Students and Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Instant versus Sustained Diffusion of YouTube Videos: A Multimodal Analysis of Content Characteristics
detail.abstract: Despite an emerging body of research on online content diffusion, there has been little to no investigation of how content characteristics drive distinct temporal diffusion patterns. This study addresses this gap by investigating two primary questions: (1) What are the main diffusion patterns of online videos? (2) Which specific content characteristics influence these patterns? We estimate the Bass diffusion model on a random sample of one million YouTube videos and identify 42,046 videos with highly predictable temporal diffusion patterns. Using K-means clustering, we find that these videos fall under two broad types: (1) instant diffusion (rapid spike followed by quick decline), (2) sustained diffusion (steady growth over time). Guided by Dual Process Theory, we apply state-of-the-art machine learning methods-(1) Spotify audio analysis, (2) Whisper transcription, (3) Sentence-BERT embeddings, and (4) Topic modeling-to extract audio, visual, and textual features corresponding to System 1 (fast, emotional) versus System 2 (slow, analytical) cognitive processes. Logistic regression analyses reveal that instant diffusion is associated with high-energy, emotionally engaging content (System 1), whereas sustained diffusion is associated with informational density and complexity (System 2). Viewer engagement metrics (comment complexity, delayed sharing, longer watch times) further validate these cognitive distinctions. Our findings can be used by YouTube content creators to design video content that is tailored to achieve specific temporal viewership objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析100万个YouTube视频，识别出两种主要扩散模式：即时扩散（快速爆发后迅速衰退）和持续扩散（随时间稳定增长），并发现即时扩散与高能量、情感化内容（系统1认知）相关，而持续扩散与信息密度和复杂性（系统2认知）相关。
AI.research_question: 1. 在线视频的主要扩散模式是什么？2. 哪些具体的内容特征影响这些扩散模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有关于在线内容扩散的研究，但很少有研究探讨内容特征如何驱动不同的时间扩散模式，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双过程理论（Dual Process Theory）- 系统1（快速、情感化）和系统2（缓慢、分析性）认知过程
AI.method: 1. 使用Bass扩散模型分析100万个YouTube视频随机样本；2. K-means聚类识别扩散模式；3. 机器学习方法提取音频、视觉和文本特征（Spotify音频分析、Whisper转录、Sentence-BERT嵌入、主题建模）；4. 逻辑回归分析内容特征与扩散模式的关系
AI.findings: 识别出两种主要扩散模式：即时扩散（快速爆发后衰退）和持续扩散（稳定增长）。即时扩散与高能量、情感化内容（系统1）相关，持续扩散与信息密度和复杂性（系统2）相关。观众参与度指标进一步验证了这些认知差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双过程理论应用于在线内容扩散研究，揭示了不同认知过程对应不同的时间扩散模式，为理解内容特征如何影响扩散动态提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可供YouTube内容创作者用于设计视频内容，以实现特定的时间观看目标，如追求短期爆发或长期稳定增长。

title: Using Content Analysis to Explore What Organizational Documents Say About What We Truly Value
affiliations: Central Michigan University - Department of Marketing and Hospitality Services Administration

detail.title: Using Content Analysis to Explore What Organizational Documents Say About What We Truly Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This case explores how academic department bylaws, an often-overlooked type of organizational document, can be used as data in qualitative content analysis. It's based on a study at a mid-sized, unionized university in the Midwest that was trying to increase faculty participation in program-level assessment. While classroom assessment is routine and tied to individual syllabi and grades, program assessment looks at whether students, as a group, have learned what a degree promises to deliver. It's a quality control mechanism, which is essential for accreditation and institutional credibility. The university had made program assessment a high-profile priority. They funded faculty travel to assessment conferences, gave out monetary awards for strong assessment plans, and offered summer stipends for faculty who wanted to improve their programs. But few faculty showed up. Participation was flat. The incentives weren't working. This led to a question: If administrators say assessment is important, is that reflected in the policies that govern what faculty get rewarded for? Using Schein's (1984) model of organizational culture, this study examined whether assessment work was embedded in departmental bylaws, the formal documents that guide promotion, tenure, and reappointment. The research involved 40 departments and more than 1,100 pages of documents. The case describes how we approached sampling, designed our categories, and handled coding decisions. Readers will learn how to conduct document-based research and explore how artefacts, like organizational documents, can reveal deeper cultural tensions within organizations. They will also come to understand that, although documents appear static and risk-free, researchers must consider the potential ethical and unintended downstream implications of their findings. Specifically, they will see how a collaborative approach using consensus coding within a summative content analysis framework can be applied to interpret complex textual data. Learning Outcomes Having read this case study, readers should be able to. . • Describe how artefacts reflect an organization's espoused and enacted values using Schein's cultural framework. • Evaluate the application of collaborative, consensus-based coding within a summative content analysis framework to accurately interpret complex and often implicit meanings in textual data. • Interpret examples of how cultural meaning can be revealed through the analysis of organizational documents. • Evaluate the ethical considerations and potential risks of conducting document-based research.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了如何利用学术部门章程作为定性内容分析的数据源，通过分析40个部门的1100多页文件，发现尽管学校管理层强调评估工作的重要性，但在决定教师晋升和任期的部门章程中却很少体现评估工作，揭示了组织宣称价值观与实际奖励机制之间的文化张力。
AI.research_question: 如果管理人员说评估很重要，那么这种重要性是否反映在决定教师获得奖励的政策中？具体而言，评估工作是否被嵌入到指导晋升、任期和重新任命的部门章程中？
AI.motivation: 尽管大学将项目评估作为高度优先事项并提供各种激励措施（如会议资助、奖金和暑期津贴），但教师参与度仍然很低，这表明激励措施无效，需要探究组织政策是否真正支持评估工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用Schein（1984）的组织文化模型，通过分析组织文物（部门章程）来揭示组织宣称的价值观与实际执行的价值观之间的差异。
AI.method: 采用总结性内容分析框架，对40个部门的1100多页章程文件进行协作共识编码，通过定性内容分析方法分析文本数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现，尽管学校管理层强调评估的重要性，但在决定教师奖励和晋升的部门章程中，评估工作很少被正式纳入，揭示了组织宣称价值观与实际奖励机制之间的脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Schein组织文化理论在高等教育环境中的应用，展示了如何通过分析组织文件来揭示深层次的文化张力和价值观冲突。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供了改进评估工作的具体建议，强调需要将评估工作正式纳入教师奖励和晋升政策中，同时为研究者提供了进行文件研究的伦理考量和方法指导。

title: Ecological Costs of Energy Infrastructure: Evidence from Migratory Bird Tracking
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China, Cornell University, Hunan Agricultural University, Renmin University of China and Hunan City University

detail.title: Ecological Costs of Energy Infrastructure: Evidence from Migratory Bird Tracking
detail.abstract: Human activities increasingly disrupt ecosystems, yet the economic costs of energy infrastructure on migratory species remain underexplored. Using over 200 million GPS tracking records of migratory birds and a national database of Chinese power plants from 2014 to 2022, we show that plant construction significantly reduces bird stopover duration by 54.4% within 50 km, with effects persisting over years. Plant decommissioning generates ecological recovery, though the magnitude is smaller. We identify habitat alterations, air pollution, and water pollution as key mechanisms. By quantifying the economic consequences of energy infrastructure on migratory birds, this study advances the integration of biodiversity impacts into economic research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2亿多条候鸟GPS追踪数据和2014-2022年中国发电厂数据库，发现电厂建设使50公里内候鸟停歇时间减少54.4%，且影响持续多年。电厂退役能带来生态恢复，但恢复程度较小。研究识别了栖息地改变、空气污染和水污染三大机制，并量化了能源基础设施对候鸟的经济影响。
AI.research_question: 能源基础设施如何影响候鸟迁徙行为及其经济成本？
AI.motivation: 人类活动日益破坏生态系统，但能源基础设施对迁徙物种的经济成本研究不足，需要将生物多样性影响纳入经济研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生态经济学和环境经济学理论，关注人类基础设施对野生动物行为的影响及其经济价值评估。
AI.method: 使用2亿多条候鸟GPS追踪记录和2014-2022年中国发电厂国家级数据库进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 电厂建设显著减少50公里内候鸟停歇时间54.4%，影响持续多年；电厂退役产生生态恢复但程度较小；关键机制包括栖息地改变、空气污染和水污染。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物多样性影响系统整合到经济研究中，发展了能源基础设施生态影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源政策制定提供科学依据，量化了基础设施对候鸟的经济影响，支持可持续发展决策。

title: AI-Powered Banking in Revolutionizing Fraud Detection: Enhancing Machine Learning to Secure Financial Transactions
affiliations: CGI Business Consulting

detail.title: AI-Powered Banking in Revolutionizing Fraud Detection: Enhancing Machine Learning to Secure Financial Transactions

publicationDetails.detailsText: SEEJPH Volume XX, 2023; 10.5281/zenodo.15825650 [undefined]

detail.abstract: With the constant evolution of financial fraud techniques, the demand for advanced technological solutions to secure banking transactions and protect sensitive information is at an all-time high. For this reason, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have been adopted as game-changing agents in improving fraud detection and prevention. These technologies allow for real-time anomaly detection, pattern identification, and predictive analytics, revolutionizing the conventional approach to fraud detection. This article explores how AI-enabled fraud detection platforms are transforming the banking industry, specifically in the areas of cyber security, real-time transaction review, and risk management in high-frequency trading. We present a suite of new techniques to enhance the precision and proficiency of fraud detection models. Specifically, it includes the Splaso Quash Filter, a data preprocessing approach designed to optimize raw data for machine learning models, and Ripe Horn Twin Fish Optimization, a lucid feature extraction technique that improves the ability of the model to detect the critical variables affecting fraud. It uses the Adaptive Neuro Boosted Forest (ANBF) algorithm which is a combination of the neural network's adaptability and the robustness of the use of error information from the decision forest to improve the decision accuracy more than the algorithm band in the decision. We also delve into the Hash Blue Hellman Algorithm, a form of cryptography that secures the storage of data and offers a protective approach for sensitive data transactions. We discuss the implications of using AI for fraudulent activity detection, including regulatory issues, potential negative consequences, and future trends in banking fraud prevention technologies. Experimentation was conducted on the Bank Fraud Detection Dataset under a Python environment. From the analysis, it was revealed that the suggested methodology offers secure financial transactions and maintains trust in the banking industry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于人工智能的银行欺诈检测系统，包含Splaso Quash Filter数据预处理、Ripe Horn Twin Fish Optimization特征提取、Adaptive Neuro Boosted Forest算法和Hash Blue Hellman加密技术，在银行欺诈检测数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能和机器学习技术提高银行欺诈检测的准确性和效率？
AI.motivation: 随着金融欺诈技术的不断演变，传统欺诈检测方法已无法满足实时性和准确性要求，需要采用先进技术来保护银行交易安全和敏感信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能和机器学习理论，结合数据预处理、特征提取、集成学习和密码学技术构建欺诈检测框架。
AI.method: 提出Splaso Quash Filter数据预处理方法、Ripe Horn Twin Fish Optimization特征提取技术、Adaptive Neuro Boosted Forest算法和Hash Blue Hellman加密算法，在Python环境下使用银行欺诈检测数据集进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够提供安全的金融交易，并维持银行业信任，在欺诈检测精度和效率方面表现出色。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的数据预处理和特征提取技术，开发了结合神经网络和决策森林优势的ANBF算法，为AI在金融欺诈检测领域的理论发展做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行业提供了实用的实时欺诈检测解决方案，有助于提升网络安全、实时交易审查和高频交易风险管理能力，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Israel's Strategic Mistake: Why the Strike on Qatar Undermines International Law
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Israel's Strategic Mistake: Why the Strike on Qatar Undermines International Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently and was not influenced by any personal or financial relationship with individuals or organizations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or case studies requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The Israeli strike on Qatari territory represents not only a regional escalation but also one of the gravest breaches of international norms in recent decades. Unlike prior operations in Syria, Lebanon, or Iran-where Israel justified its actions within the context of active hostilities-Qatar is neither a belligerent state nor an adversary. Instead, it functions as a U.S.-backed mediator, a pivotal global LNG supplier, and host to the largest American military base in the Middle East. Targeting such a state elevates the incident into a strategic miscalculation with systemic consequences. This paper contends that the strike constitutes a violation of international law, undermines mediation channels, and sets a perilous precedent that undermines both regional stability and the credibility of the international rules-based order. For this analysis, Third Generation Diplomacy refers to a new model of international engagement that integrates digital technologies, algorithmic governance, and ethical innovation. This concept is introduced as an alternative to outdated negotiation frameworks, highlighting the urgency of adapting diplomacy to contemporary challenges. This paper is guided by a central question: If the unraveling of the international order begins not with great-power confrontation but with the strike on a small mediator state like Qatar, what does this imply for the future of global governance and diplomacy?

AI.tldr: 以色列袭击卡塔尔领土不仅是地区局势升级，更是对国际规范的严重破坏。本文认为此次袭击违反国际法、破坏调解渠道，并设定了危险先例，威胁区域稳定和国际秩序。
AI.research_question: 如果国际秩序的瓦解不是始于大国对抗，而是始于对卡塔尔这样的小型调解国的袭击，这对全球治理和外交的未来意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 以色列袭击卡塔尔这一非交战国和调解国，构成了战略误判和系统性后果，需要分析其对国际法和外交实践的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第三代外交理论 - 整合数字技术、算法治理和伦理创新的新型国际交往模式，作为传统谈判框架的替代方案。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究方法，基于国际法原则和外交实践对袭击事件进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 袭击违反国际法规范，破坏调解渠道，设定危险先例，威胁区域稳定和国际规则秩序的可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出第三代外交理论框架，强调外交实践需要适应数字时代和技术创新的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会提供应对类似危机的政策建议，强调保护调解国地位和维护国际法规范的重要性。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2025/3110
title: The Signaling Effects of Fiscal Announcements
affiliations: University of Warwick, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Sveriges Riksbank - Research Division and University of Oxford

detail.title: The Signaling Effects of Fiscal Announcements

publicationDetails.detailsText: ECB Working Paper No. 2025/3110
publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Announcing a large fiscal stimulus may signal the government’s pessimism about the severity of a recession to the private sector, impairing the stabilizing effects of the policy. Using a theoretical model, we show that these signaling effects occur when the stimulus exceeds expectations and are more noticeable during periods of high economic uncertainty. Analysis of a new dataset of daily stock prices and fiscal news in Japan supports these predictions. We introduce a method to identify fiscal news with different degrees of signaling effects and find that such effects weaken or, in extreme cases, even completely undermine the stabilizing impact of the announcements.

AI.tldr: 财政刺激政策如果超出市场预期，可能向私营部门传递政府悲观信号，反而削弱政策稳定效果，这种信号效应在经济不确定性高时更明显。
AI.research_question: 财政刺激政策宣布是否会通过信号效应削弱其稳定经济的效果？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为财政刺激能稳定经济，但政策宣布可能传递政府悲观信息，反而产生负面信号效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论，政府政策宣布作为信息传递机制，可能产生意外的信号效应。
AI.method: 理论模型分析+日本股市日度数据和财政新闻的新数据集实证分析
AI.findings: 当刺激政策超出预期时会产生信号效应，高经济不确定性时期效应更显著，信号效应可能完全抵消政策的稳定作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了财政政策的信号效应理论框架，揭示了政策宣布可能产生的意外负面后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了识别不同信号效应程度财政新闻的方法，为政策制定者设计更有效的财政刺激提供了指导。

title: The Effect of Aging Workforces on the Digital Transformation: Evidence from South Korea
affiliations: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade and Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade

detail.title: The Effect of Aging Workforces on the Digital Transformation: Evidence from South Korea

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 25/IER/30/04/03
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 30, No. 4, pp. 36-47

detail.abstract:
Historically, older workers were often regarded as valuable assets in traditional industrial settings due to their skills and experience. But the industrial environment is now characterized by the rapid adoption of advanced digital technologies. Older workers tend to adopt new technologies at a slower rate compared to younger generations; for firms striving to maximize productivity and competitiveness, this drawback makes the employment of older workers less attractive than in the past. 

Given the above, it is worth examining the characteristics of an aging workforce in relation to the digital transformation to produce insights that can inform industrial and workforce policy. For this study, we focus on assessing the impact of workforce aging on firms’ adoption of digital technologies. Specifically, we aim to quantitatively evaluate how the proportion of older employees within different industries affects the adoption and utilization of digital transformation technologies. Through this analysis, we seek to better understand the interaction between workforce composition and digital innovation, and ultimately offer policy insights to support a more inclusive and effective digital transition.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨劳动力老龄化对企业数字化转型技术采用的影响，通过定量分析不同行业中老年员工比例对数字技术采纳和使用的影响，旨在为产业和劳动力政策提供见解。
AI.research_question: 劳动力老龄化如何影响企业数字技术的采用和利用？
AI.motivation: 在快速数字化的工业环境中，年长员工采用新技术的速度较慢，这可能使企业在追求生产力和竞争力时对雇佣年长员工失去兴趣，需要研究这一现象以制定更包容的数字转型政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力老龄化与技术创新采纳理论，关注代际技术接受差异对组织数字化转型的影响。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过分析不同行业中老年员工比例与数字技术采用程度的数据关系进行评估。
AI.findings: 预计研究发现老年员工比例较高的企业在数字技术采纳方面可能存在滞后，但具体影响程度因行业特征而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富劳动力老龄化与数字化转型关系的理论理解，为代际技术采纳差异研究提供实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供关于如何平衡劳动力老龄化与数字化转型的实用见解，支持更具包容性的数字过渡策略制定。

title: Economic Relativity: A Cut Rule for Perimeter Valuation in Equity Ownership Networks

detail.title: Economic Relativity: A Cut Rule for Perimeter Valuation in Equity Ownership Networks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We introduce the Cut-Based Valuation (CBV), a unified framework for consolidated value in equity/flow networks. The central idea is that economic value is never absolute: it is always defined relative to an observer Ω, which fixes perimeter, measurement basis, units/FX/PPP, discounting, informational regime, and control rules. Given Ω, the Cut Theorem shows that the consolidated value of a perimeter P depends only on boundary quantities across the cut P ↔ O, while internal reconnections are valuation-invariant. This provides (i) sufficient statistics for valuation with linear computational complexity, (ii) standardized reporting through the Perimeter-of-Validity and Cut Summary, and (iii) transformation laws that clarify how different observers relate. Applications span IFRS consolidation, national accounts, fund-of-funds, pyramids, and clearing networks, all seen as special cases of a general principle of economic relativity. Case studies (market capitalization by country, keiretsu, fund-of-funds) illustrate how CBV eliminates double counting while ensuring comparability and auditability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于切割的估值框架(CBV)，通过引入观察者概念统一处理股权/资金网络中的合并估值问题，证明了估值只取决于边界量而非内部连接，具有线性计算复杂度并确保可比性和可审计性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的框架来处理股权和资金网络中的合并估值问题，确保估值的一致性和可比性？
AI.motivation: 传统估值方法在处理复杂的股权结构、资金网络和合并报表时存在双重计算、缺乏可比性和审计困难等问题，需要一种理论统一的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于切割的估值理论(CBV)，引入观察者概念(Ω)来定义估值相对性，包括边界、计量基础、单位、贴现、信息制度和控制规则等维度。
AI.method: 理论推导和数学证明，通过切割定理证明估值只取决于边界量，内部重新连接对估值不变，并应用案例研究验证框架的有效性。
AI.findings: CBV框架提供了(i)线性计算复杂度的充分统计量，(ii)通过有效边界和切割摘要实现标准化报告，(iii)不同观察者之间的转换规律。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济相对性的一般原则，统一处理IFRS合并、国民账户、基金中的基金、金字塔结构和清算网络等特殊案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 消除了双重计算问题，确保了估值的可比性和可审计性，为复杂的股权和资金网络估值提供了实用的标准化工具。
